104  /* Remove duplicate list entries */
105  void getUnique( Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* > & list )
106  {
107  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* >::iterator start = list.begin();
108  unsigned int size = list.size();
109  unsigned int i, j;
110 
111  if ( size > 1 )
112  {
113  for ( i = 0; i < size - 1; i++ )
114  {
115  j = i + 1;
116  while ( j < size )
117  {
118  SgVarRefExp* iis = isSgVarRefExp( list.at(i) );
119  SgVarRefExp* jjs = isSgVarRefExp( list.at(j) );
120 
121  SgInitializedName* is = isSgInitializedName( iis->get_symbol()->get_declaration() );
122  SgInitializedName* js = isSgInitializedName( jjs->get_symbol()->get_declaration() );
123  if ( is == js )
124  {
125  list.erase( start + j );
126  size--;
127  continue;
128  }
129 
130  j++;
131  }
132  }
133  }
134  }

166  // Check if a variable is explicitly specified by clauses of omp_clause_body_stmt. Return e_unknown if not.
167  static omp_construct_enum getExplicitDataSharingAttribute (SgInitializedName* iname, SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* omp_clause_body_stmt)
168  {
169  ROSE_ASSERT (iname != NULL);
170  ROSE_ASSERT (omp_clause_body_stmt != NULL);
171 
172  omp_construct_enum rt_val = e_unknown;
173  if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpPrivateClause))
174  {
175  rt_val = e_private;
176  }
177  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpSharedClause))
178  {
179  rt_val = e_shared;
180  }
181  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpReductionClause))
182  {
183  rt_val = e_reduction;
184  }
185  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpCopyinClause))
186  {
187  rt_val = e_copyin;
188  }
189  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpCopyprivateClause))
190  {
191  rt_val = e_copyprivate;
192  }
193  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause))
194  {
195  rt_val = e_firstprivate;
196  }
197  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpLastprivateClause))
198  {
199  rt_val = e_lastprivate;
200  }
201  else if (isInClauseVariableList( iname, omp_clause_body_stmt, V_SgOmpMapClause))
202  {
203  rt_val = e_map;
204  }
205 
206  return rt_val;
207  }

222  // TODO: expose to header
223  // From collapse(Integer), find all affected for loops of a 'omp for' or 'omp simd' directive
224  // In this case, normalizing combined constructs like 'parallel for' is convenient, less directives to consider.
225  vector <SgForStatement* > getAffectedForLoops (SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* forOrSimd)
226  {
227  vector <SgForStatement* > loops;
228  ROSE_ASSERT (forOrSimd != NULL);
229  int loop_count = 1; // by default, only one loop is affected.
230  SgExpression* exp = getClauseExpression (forOrSimd, V_SgOmpCollapseClause);
231  SgExpression* exp_ordered = getClauseExpression (forOrSimd, V_SgOmpOrderedClause);
232  if (exp !=NULL)
233  {
234  SgIntVal * ival = isSgIntVal(exp);
235  if (ival == NULL)
236  {
237  cerr<<"Error. Expecting SgIntVal of Collapse(exp), seeing "<<exp->class_name() << " instead."<<endl;
238  ROSE_ABORT ();
239  }
240  loop_count = ival->get_value();
241  }
242  else if (exp_ordered !=NULL)
243  {
244  SgIntVal * ival = isSgIntVal(exp_ordered);
245  if (ival == NULL) // ordered clause may have no expression specified at all. default to 1 loop affected.
246  loop_count = 1;
247  else
248  loop_count = ival->get_value();
249  }
250  // TODO: what if both ordered() and collapse() appear??
251 
252  // Now obtain all loops within forOrSimd, up to loop_count
253  RoseAst ast (forOrSimd);
254  for(RoseAst::iterator i=ast.begin();i!=ast.end();++i) {
255  if (loop_count==0)
256  break;
257  if (SgForStatement* fs = isSgForStatement (*i))
258  {
259  loops.push_back(fs);
260  loop_count --;
261  }
262  }
263  return loops;
264  }

299  // The rules are defined in OpenMP 4.5 specification, page 179,
300  // 2.15.1 Data-sharing Attribute Rules
301  omp_construct_enum getDataSharingAttribute (SgSymbol* sym, SgNode* anchor_node)
302  {
303  omp_construct_enum rt_val = e_shared; // shared by default for now
304  //TODO: if default() is present, we have to change this.
305  ROSE_ASSERT (sym != NULL);
306  ROSE_ASSERT (anchor_node!= NULL);
307  SgStatement* anchor_stmt = getEnclosingStatement (anchor_node);
308  ROSE_ASSERT (anchor_stmt != NULL);
309 
310  SgVariableSymbol * var_sym = isSgVariableSymbol (sym);
311  ROSE_ASSERT (var_sym!= NULL);
312 
313  SgInitializedName* iname = isSgInitializedName( var_sym->get_declaration() );
314  //TODO: what to do with SgOmpWorkshareStatement ? it is a region/SgOmpBodyStatement, but it does not belong to OmpClauseBodyStatement
315 
316  // obtain the enclosing OpenMP clause body statement: SgOmpForStatement, parallel, sections, single, target, target data, task, etc.
317  // TODO: this may not be reliable: region {stmtlist ; loop; stmtlist; }
318  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* omp_clause_body_stmt = findEnclosingOmpClauseBodyStatement (anchor_stmt);
319 
320  if (omp_clause_body_stmt != NULL)
321  {
322  omp_construct_enum temp_val = getExplicitDataSharingAttribute (iname, omp_clause_body_stmt);
323  // We assume the input code is correct. So all predetermined variables listed in clauses are conforming to the spec.
324  if (temp_val != e_unknown)
325  {
326  rt_val = temp_val ;
327  return rt_val; // use direct return to avoid messy if-else logic
328  }
329  // not explicitly specified, using the rules for predetermined and implicitly determined
330  else
331  {
332  //Not in explicit data-sharing attribute clause at this level,
333 
334  // Apply implicit rules :
335  // check if it is locally declared (the declaration is inside of the omp_clause_body_stmt )
336  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl = isSgVariableDeclaration(iname->get_declaration());
337  // ROSE_ASSERT (var_decl != NULL);
338  // it could also be SgFunctionParameterList or other declarations
339  // if declared at function parameters, the scope is outside, it should be shared by default if no other rules apply.
340  if (var_decl && isAncestor (omp_clause_body_stmt, var_decl))
341  {
342  // declared in a scope inside the construct:
343  // Variables with automatic storage duration are private
344  // Variables with static storage duration are shared.
345  if (isStatic (var_decl))
346  rt_val = e_shared;
347  else
348  rt_val = e_private;
349  return rt_val;
350  }
351 
352  if (isThreadprivate (sym))
353  // Variables appearing in threadprivate directives are threadprivate.
354  {
355  rt_val = e_threadprivate;
356  return rt_val;
357  }
358 
359  // Check if a SgInitializedName is used as a loop index within a AST subtree.
360  // This function will use a bottom-up traverse starting from the subtree_root to find
361  // all enclosing loops and check if ivar is used as an index for either of them.
362 // if (isLoopIndexVariable (iname, anchor_stmt)) // TODO: need more work here
363  // not just any loop variables, but these affected by the OpenMP directives
364  if (isAffectedForLoopIndexVariable ( omp_clause_body_stmt, iname ))
365  {
366  /* loop iteration variable
367  private: The loop iteration variable(s) in the associated for-loop(s) of a for, parallel for,
368  taskloop, or distribute construct.
369 
370  linear: The loop iteration variable in the associated for-loop of a simd construct with just one
371  associated for-loop is linear with a linear-step that is the increment of the associated for-loop.
372 
373  lastprivate: The loop iteration variables in the associated for-loops of a simd construct with multiple
374  associated for-loops are lastprivate.
375  */
376  if (isSgOmpForStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt))
377  // TODO: check other types of constructs here: taskloop, distribute construct
378  {
379  rt_val = e_private;
380  return rt_val;
381  }
382  else if (SgOmpSimdStatement* simd_stmt = isSgOmpSimdStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt))
383  {
384  // if simd+ multiple affected loops: lastprivate(). We check collapse() to see if multiple loops are affected.
385  // TODO: we need to check if collapse(val) val >=1
386  if (hasClause(simd_stmt, V_SgOmpCollapseClause))
387  {
388  rt_val = e_lastprivate;
389  }
390  else
391  rt_val = e_linear;
392  return rt_val;
393  }
394  else
395  {
396  //cerr<<"found a loop index, but enclosing body statement is not omp for, but "<<omp_clause_body_stmt->class_name() <<endl;
397  }
398  }
399  // Important algorithm step here:
400  // No this logic in the specification, but I split the combined parallel for into two constructs, need to double check this
401  // another case is parallel region + single region, we need to get the parallel region's attribute
402  // Similar handling for simd directives, going after parent omp parallel or omp for if there is any, to find out the attributes.
403  // parallel+ for + simd: three levels
404  //
405  // #pragma omp parallel private(i,j)
406  // {
407  // for (i = 0; i < LOOPCOUNT; i++)
408  // {
409  // #pragma omp single copyprivate(j)
410  // {
411  // nr_iterations++;
412  // j = i; // i should be private, based on enclosing parallel region's info.
413  // }
414  // }
415  //
416  // If implicit rules do not apply at this level (worksharing regions like single), Go to find higher level: most omp parallel
417  if (SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * parent_clause_body_stmt = findEnclosingOmpClauseBodyStatement (getEnclosingStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt->get_parent())))
418  {
419  //if (isSgOmpParallelStatement (parent_clause_body_stmt) && ( isSgOmpForStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt)|| isSgOmpSingleStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt) ) )
420  //if (isSgOmpParallelStatement (parent_clause_body_stmt) && isSgOmpSingleStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt))
421  // TODO: add other directives which may be nested within others
422  if (isSgOmpForStatement (omp_clause_body_stmt) ||
423  isSgOmpSimdStatement (omp_clause_body_stmt) ||
424  isSgOmpSingleStatement(omp_clause_body_stmt))
425  {
426  // we need to consider the variable's data sharing attribute in the new context
427  // the body of parallel can be the single region again, causing infinite recursive calls.
428  //rt_val = getDataSharingAttribute (sym, parent_clause_body_stmt->get_body());
429  rt_val = getDataSharingAttribute (sym, parent_clause_body_stmt);
430  return rt_val;
431  }
432  }
433 
434  // TODO: If an array section is a list item in a map clause on the target construct and the array section is
435  // derived from a variable for which the type is pointer then that variable is firstprivate.
436  } // end explicit unknown
437 
438  // the rest is shared by default
439  // TODO Objects with dynamic storage duration are shared.
440  // TODO Static data members are shared.
441 
442  } // end of has an OpenMP enclosing clause body statement
443  else //orphaned code segments
444  {
445 /*
446  For the data race detection project, we choose to inline everything. So the implementation of orphaned segs is lower priority.
447  //TODO: handle more cases as needed.
448  Variables with static storage duration that are declared in called routines in the region are shared.
449 
450  File-scope or namespace-scope variables referenced in called routines in the region are shared
451  unless they appear in a threadprivate directive.
452 
453  Objects with dynamic storage duration are shared.
454 
455  Static data members are shared unless they appear in a threadprivate directive.
456 
457  In C++, formal arguments of called routines in the region that are passed by reference have the
458  same data-sharing attributes as the associated actual arguments.
459 
460  Other variables declared in called routines in the region are private.
461 */
462  if (isThreadprivate (sym))
463  {
464  rt_val = e_threadprivate;
465  return rt_val;
466  }
467  else
468  {
469  //find locally declared variables
470  SgDeclarationStatement* var_decl = iname->get_declaration();
471  SgFunctionDefinition* func_def = getEnclosingFunctionDefinition (anchor_stmt);
472  ROSE_ASSERT (func_def != NULL);
473  if (isAncestor (func_def, var_decl))
474  {
475  rt_val = e_private;
476  return rt_val;
477  }
478  // if it is within a main function, it should be private no matter what. Single sequential region, not shared with others.
479  if (isMain (func_def->get_declaration()))
480  {
481  rt_val = e_private;
482  return rt_val;
483  }
484  }
485  } // end of orphaned code segments
486 
487  return rt_val;
488  }

507  int patchUpSharedVariables(SgFile* file)
508  {
509 
510  int result = 0; // record for the number of shared variables added
511 
512  ROSE_ASSERT( file != NULL );
513  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* > allParallelRegion = NodeQuery::querySubTree( file, V_SgOmpParallelStatement );
514  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* >::iterator allParallelRegionItr = allParallelRegion.begin();
515 
516  for( ; allParallelRegionItr != allParallelRegion.end(); allParallelRegionItr++ )
517  {
519  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* > expressions = NodeQuery::querySubTree( *allParallelRegionItr, V_SgExprStatement );
521  //TODO: this may miss the constant variables referenced in data type declaration. e.g. int a[length];
522  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* > allRef;
523  gatherReferences(expressions, allRef );
524 
526  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* > localVariables = NodeQuery::querySubTree( *allParallelRegionItr, V_SgVariableDeclaration );
527 
529  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* >::iterator allRefItr = allRef.begin();
530  while( allRefItr != allRef.end() )
531  {
532  SgVarRefExp* item = isSgVarRefExp( *allRefItr );
533  string varName = item->get_symbol()->get_name().getString();
534 
535  Rose_STL_Container< SgNode* >::iterator localVariablesItr = localVariables.begin();
536 
537  bool isLocal = false; // record whether this variable should be added into shared clause
538 
539  while( localVariablesItr != localVariables.end() )
540  {
541  SgInitializedNamePtrList vars = ((SgVariableDeclaration*)(*localVariablesItr))->get_variables();
542 
543  string localName = vars.at(0)->get_name().getString();
544  if( varName == localName )
545  {
546  isLocal = true;
547  }
548  localVariablesItr++;
549 
550  }
551 
552  bool isInPrivate = false;
553  SgInitializedName* reg = isSgInitializedName( item->get_symbol()->get_declaration() );
554 
555  isInPrivate = isInClauseVariableList( reg, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement( *allParallelRegionItr ), V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
556 
557  bool isInShared = false;
558 
559  isInShared = isInClauseVariableList( reg, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement( *allParallelRegionItr ), V_SgOmpSharedClause );
560 
561  bool isInFirstprivate = false;
562 
563  isInFirstprivate = isInClauseVariableList( reg, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement( *allParallelRegionItr ), V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause );
564 
565  bool isInReduction = false;
566 
567  isInReduction = isInClauseVariableList( reg, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement( *allParallelRegionItr ), V_SgOmpReductionClause );
568 
569  if( !isLocal && !isInShared && !isInPrivate && !isInFirstprivate && ! isInReduction )
570  {
571  std::cout<<" the insert variable is: "<<item->unparseToString()<<std::endl;
572  addClauseVariable( reg, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement( * allParallelRegionItr ), V_SgOmpSharedClause );
573  result++;
574  std::cout<<" successfully !"<<std::endl;
575  }
576  allRefItr++;
577  }
578 
579 
580  } // end of all parallel region
581 
582  return result;
583  } // the end of patchUpSharedVariables()

828  /* This function is mostly used by transOmpVariables() to handle private, firstprivate, reduction, etc.

832  int replaceVariableReferences(SgNode* root, VariableSymbolMap_t varRemap)

836  NodeList_t refs = NodeQuery::querySubTree (root, V_SgVarRefExp);

840  ROSE_ASSERT (ref_orig);

852  ref_orig->set_symbol( newSym);

889  {

896  return copyExpression(orig_stride);

902  // Static schedule include: default schedule, or schedule(static[,chunk_size])
903  bool useStaticSchedule(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* omp_loop)
904  {

906  bool result= false;

915  ROSE_ASSERT(s_clause);

917  result = true;
918  }
919  return result;

933  // Convert a schedule kind enum value to a small case string
934  string toString(SgOmpClause::omp_schedule_kind_enum s_kind)
935  {
936  string result ;
937  if (s_kind == SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_static)
938  {
939  result = "static";
940  } else if (s_kind == SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_dynamic)
941  {
942  result = "dynamic";
943  }
944  else if (s_kind == SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_guided)
945  {
946  result = "guided";
947  }
948  else if (s_kind == SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_runtime)
949  {
950  result = "runtime";
951  }
952  else if (s_kind == SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_auto)
953  {
954  // cerr<<"GOMP does not provide an implementation for schedule(auto)....."<<endl;
955  result = "auto";
956  } else
957  {
958  cerr<<"Error: illegal or unhandled schedule kind:"<< s_kind<<endl;
959  ROSE_ABORT();
960  }
961  return result;
962  }

1137  static void transOmpLoop_others(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* target,
1138  SgVariableDeclaration* index_decl, SgVariableDeclaration* lower_decl, SgVariableDeclaration* upper_decl,
1139  SgBasicBlock* bb1)
1140  {
1141  ROSE_ASSERT (target != NULL);
1142  ROSE_ASSERT (index_decl != NULL);
1143  ROSE_ASSERT (lower_decl != NULL);
1144  ROSE_ASSERT (upper_decl != NULL);
1145  ROSE_ASSERT (bb1 != NULL);
1146 
1147  SgScopeStatement* p_scope = target->get_scope();
1148  ROSE_ASSERT (p_scope != NULL);
1149  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
1150  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
1151  // The OpenMP syntax requires that the omp for pragma is immediately followed by the for loop.
1152  SgForStatement * for_loop = isSgForStatement(body);
1153  SgFortranDo* do_loop = isSgFortranDo(body);
1154  SgStatement * loop = for_loop!=NULL? (SgStatement*)for_loop:(SgStatement*)do_loop;
1155 
1156  SgInitializedName* orig_index;
1157  SgExpression* orig_lower, * orig_upper, * orig_stride;
1158  bool isIncremental = true; // if the loop iteration space is incremental
1159  // grab the original loop 's controlling information
1160  bool is_canonical = false;
1161  if (for_loop)
1162  is_canonical = isCanonicalForLoop (for_loop, &orig_index, & orig_lower, &orig_upper, &orig_stride, NULL, &isIncremental);
1163  else if (do_loop)
1164  {
1165  is_canonical = isCanonicalDoLoop (do_loop, &orig_index, & orig_lower, &orig_upper, &orig_stride, NULL, &isIncremental, NULL);
1166  insert_libxompf_h (do_loop);
1167  }
1168  else
1169  {
1170  cerr<<"error! transOmpLoop_others(). loop is neither for_loop nor do_loop. Aborting.."<<endl;
1171  ROSE_ABORT ();
1172  }
1173  ROSE_ASSERT(is_canonical == true);
1174 
1175  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> clauses = getClause(target, V_SgOmpScheduleClause);
1176 
1177  // the case of with the ordered schedule, but without any schedule policy specified
1178  // treat it as (static, 0) based on GCC's translation
1179  SgOmpClause::omp_schedule_kind_enum s_kind = SgOmpClause::e_omp_schedule_static;
1180  SgExpression* orig_chunk_size = NULL;
1181  bool hasOrder = false;
1182  if (hasClause(target, V_SgOmpOrderedClause))

1357  // Expected AST
1358  // * SgOmpForStatement
1359  // ** SgForStatement
1360  // Algorithm:
1361  // Loop normalization first for stop condition expressions
1362  // <: for (i= 0;i <20; i++) --> for (i= 0;i <20; i+=1) [0,20, +1] to pass to runtime calls
1363  // <=: for (i= 0;i<=20; i++) --> for (i= 0;i <21; i+=1)
1364  // >: for (i=20;i >-1; i--) --> for (i=20;i >-1; i-=1) [20, -1, -1]
1365  // >=: for (i=20;i>= 0; i--) --> for (i=20;i >-1; i-=1)
1366  // We have a SageInterface::forLoopNormalization() which does the opposite (normalizing a C loop to a Fortran style loop)
1367  // < --> <= and > --> >=,
1368  // GCC-GOMP use compiler-generated statements to schedule loop iterations using static schedule
1369  // All other schedule policies use runtime calls instead.
1370  // We translate static schedule here and non-static ones in transOmpLoop_others()
1371  //
1372  // Static schedule, including:
1373  //1. default (static even) case
1374  //2. schedule(static[, chunk_size]): == static even if chunk_size is not specified
1375  // gomp does not provide a runtime call to calculate loop control values
1376  // for the default (static even) scheduling
1377  // compilers have to generate the statements to do this. I HATE THIS!!!
1378  // the loop scheduling algorithm for the default case is
1379  /*
1380  // calculate loop iteration count from lower, upper and stride , no -1 if upper is an inclusive bound
1381  int _p_iter_count = (stride + -1 + upper - lower )/stride;
1382  // calculate a proper chunk size
1383  // two cases: evenly divisible 20/5 =4
1384  // not evenly divisible 20/3= 6
1385  // Initial candidate
1386 
1387  int _p_num_threads = omp_get_num_threads ();
1388  _p_chunk_size = _p_iter_count / _p_num_threads;
1389  int _p_ck_temp = (_p_chunk_size * _p_num_threads) != _p_iter_count;
1390  // increase the chunk size by 1 if not evenly divisible
1391  _p_chunk_size = _p_ck_temp + _p_chunk_size;
1392 
1393  // decide on the lower and upper bound for the current thread
1394  int _p_thread_id = omp_get_thread_num ();
1395  _p_lower = lower + _p_chunk_size * _p_thread_id * stride;a
1396  // -1 if upper is an inclusive bound
1397  _p_upper = _p_lower + _p_chunk_size * stride;
1398 
1399  // adjust the upper bound
1400  _p_upper = MIN_EXPR <_p_upper, upper>;
1401  // _p_upper = _p_upper<upper? _p_upper: upper;
1402  // Note: decremental iteration space needs some minor changes to the algorithm above.
1403  // stride should be negated
1404  // MIN_EXP should be MAX_EXP
1405  // upper bound adjustment should be +1 instead of -1
1406  */

1592 Example:
1593  // for (i = 0; i < N; i++)
1594  { // top level block, prepare to be outlined.
1595  // int i ; // = blockDim.x * blockIdx.x + threadIdx.x; // this CUDA declaration can be inserted later

1600  for (j = 0; j < M; j++)
1601  for (k = 0; k < K; k++)
1602  c[i][j]= c[i][j]+a[i][k]*b[k][j];
1603  }

1606 Algorithm:
1607  * check if it is a OmpTargetLoop
1608  * loop normalization
1609  * replace OmpForStatement with a block: bb1
1610  * declare int _dev_i within bb1; replace for loop body’s loop index with _dev_i;
1611  * build if stmt with correct condition
1612  * move loop body to if-stmt’s true body
1613  * remove for_loop
1614  */
1615  void transOmpTargetLoop(SgNode* node)
1616  {
1617  //step 0: Sanity check
1618  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
1619  SgOmpForStatement* target1 = isSgOmpForStatement(node);
1620  SgOmpDoStatement* target2 = isSgOmpDoStatement(node);
1621 
1622  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* target = (target1!=NULL?(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement*)target1:(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement*)target2);
1623  ROSE_ASSERT (target != NULL);
1624 
1625  SgScopeStatement* p_scope = target->get_scope();
1626  ROSE_ASSERT (p_scope != NULL);
1627 
1628  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
1629  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
1630  // The OpenMP syntax requires that the omp for pragma is immediately followed by the for loop.
1631  SgForStatement * for_loop = isSgForStatement(body);
1632  SgFortranDo * do_loop = isSgFortranDo(body);
1633 
1634  SgStatement* loop = (for_loop!=NULL?(SgStatement*)for_loop:(SgStatement*)do_loop);
1635  ROSE_ASSERT (loop != NULL);
1636 
1637  // make sure this is really a loop affected by "omp target"
1638  //bool is_target_loop = false;
1639  SgNode* parent = node->get_parent();
1640  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);
1641  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent)) // skip one possible BB between omp parallel and omp for.
1642  parent = parent->get_parent();
1643  SgNode* grand_parent = parent->get_parent();
1644  ROSE_ASSERT (grand_parent != NULL);
1645  SgOmpParallelStatement* parent_parallel = isSgOmpParallelStatement (parent) ;
1646  SgOmpTargetStatement* grand_target = isSgOmpTargetStatement(grand_parent);
1647  ROSE_ASSERT (parent_parallel !=NULL);
1648  ROSE_ASSERT (grand_target !=NULL);
1649 
1650  // Step 1. Loop normalization
1651  // For the init statement: for (int i=0;... ) becomes int i; for (i=0;..)
1652  // For test expression: i<x is normalized to i<= (x-1) and i>x is normalized to i>= (x+1)
1653  // For increment expression: i++ is normalized to i+=1 and i-- is normalized to i+=-1 i-=s is normalized to i+= -s
1654  if (for_loop)
1655  SageInterface::forLoopNormalization(for_loop);
1656  else if (do_loop)
1657  SageInterface::doLoopNormalization(do_loop);
1658  else

1789 void transOmpTargetLoop_RoundRobin(SgNode* node)
1790 {
1791  //step 0: Sanity check
1792  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
1793  SgOmpForStatement* target1 = isSgOmpForStatement(node);
1794  SgOmpDoStatement* target2 = isSgOmpDoStatement(node);
1795 
1796  // the target of the translation is a SgOmpForStatement
1797  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* target = (target1!=NULL?(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement*)target1:(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement*)target2);
1798  ROSE_ASSERT (target != NULL);
1799 
1800  SgScopeStatement* p_scope = target->get_scope();
1801  ROSE_ASSERT (p_scope != NULL);
1802 
1803  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
1804  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
1805  // The OpenMP syntax requires that the omp for pragma is immediately followed by the for loop.
1806  SgForStatement * for_loop = isSgForStatement(body);
1807  SgFortranDo * do_loop = isSgFortranDo(body);
1808 
1809  SgStatement* loop = (for_loop!=NULL?(SgStatement*)for_loop:(SgStatement*)do_loop);
1810  ROSE_ASSERT (loop != NULL);
1811 
1812  // make sure this is really a loop affected by "omp target"
1813  //bool is_target_loop = false;
1814  SgNode* parent = node->get_parent();
1815  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);
1816  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent)) // skip one possible BB between omp parallel and omp for.
1817  parent = parent->get_parent();
1818  SgNode* grand_parent = parent->get_parent();
1819  ROSE_ASSERT (grand_parent != NULL);
1820  SgOmpParallelStatement* parent_parallel = isSgOmpParallelStatement (parent) ;
1821  SgOmpTargetStatement* grand_target = isSgOmpTargetStatement(grand_parent);
1822  ROSE_ASSERT (parent_parallel !=NULL);
1823  ROSE_ASSERT (grand_target !=NULL);
1824 
1825  // Step 1. Loop normalization
1826  // For the init statement: for (int i=0;... ) becomes int i; for (i=0;..)
1827  // For test expression: i<x is normalized to i<= (x-1) and i>x is normalized to i>= (x+1)
1828  // For increment expression: i++ is normalized to i+=1 and i-- is normalized to i+=-1 i-=s is normalized to i+= -s
1829  if (for_loop)
1830  SageInterface::forLoopNormalization(for_loop);
1831  else if (do_loop)
1832  SageInterface::doLoopNormalization(do_loop);
1833  else
1834  {
1835  cerr<<"error! transOmpLoop(). loop is neither for_loop nor do_loop. Aborting.."<<endl;
1836  ROSE_ABORT ();
1837  }
1838 
1839  SgInitializedName * orig_index = NULL;
1840  SgExpression* orig_lower = NULL;
1841  SgExpression* orig_upper= NULL;
1842  SgExpression* orig_stride= NULL;
1843  bool isIncremental = true; // if the loop iteration space is incremental
1844  // grab the original loop 's controlling information
1845  bool is_canonical = false;
1846 
1847  if (for_loop)
1848  is_canonical = isCanonicalForLoop (for_loop, &orig_index, & orig_lower, &orig_upper, &orig_stride, NULL, &isIncremental);
1849  else if (do_loop)
1850  is_canonical = isCanonicalDoLoop (do_loop, &orig_index, & orig_lower, &orig_upper, &orig_stride, NULL, &isIncremental, NULL);
1851  ROSE_ASSERT(is_canonical == true);
1852 
1853  // loop iteration space: upper - lower + 1, not used within this function, but a global variable used later.
1854  // This expression will be later used to help generate xomp_get_max1DBlock(VEC_LEN), which needs iteration count to calculate max thread block numbers
1855  cuda_loop_iter_count_1 = buildAddOp(buildSubtractOp(deepCopy(orig_upper), deepCopy(orig_lower)), buildIntVal(1));
1856 
1857  // TODO: Fortran support later on
1858  ROSE_ASSERT (for_loop != NULL);
1859  //SgBasicBlock* loop_body = ensureBasicBlockAsBodyOfFor (for_loop);
1860 
1861  //Step 2. Insert a basic block to replace SgOmpForStatement
1862  // This newly introduced scope is used to hold loop variables ,etc
1863  SgBasicBlock * bb1 = SageBuilder::buildBasicBlock();
1864  replaceStatement(target, bb1, true);
1865 
1866  // Insert variables used by the two scheduler functions
1867  /* int _dev_lower;
1868  int _dev_upper;
1869  int _dev_loop_chunk_size;
1870  int _dev_loop_sched_index;
1871  int _dev_loop_stride;
1872  */
1873  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_lower_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_lower", buildIntType(), NULL, bb1);
1874  appendStatement (dev_lower_decl, bb1);
1875  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_upper_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_upper", buildIntType(), NULL, bb1);
1876  appendStatement (dev_upper_decl, bb1);
1877  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_loop_chunk_size_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_loop_chunk_size", buildIntType(), NULL, bb1);
1878  appendStatement (dev_loop_chunk_size_decl, bb1);
1879  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_loop_sched_index_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_loop_sched_index", buildIntType(), NULL, bb1);
1880  appendStatement (dev_loop_sched_index_decl , bb1);
1881  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_loop_stride_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_loop_stride", buildIntType(), NULL, bb1);
1882  appendStatement (dev_loop_stride_decl, bb1);
1883 
1884  // Insert CUDA thread id and count declarations
1885  // int _dev_thread_num = getCUDABlockThreadCount(1);
1886  SgAssignInitializer* init_idx = buildAssignInitializer(buildFunctionCallExp(SgName("getCUDABlockThreadCount"), buildIntType(),buildExprListExp(buildIntVal(1)),bb1), buildIntType());
1887  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_thread_num_decl = buildVariableDeclaration("_dev_thread_num", buildIntType(), init_idx, bb1);
1888  appendStatement (dev_thread_num_decl, bb1);
1889  SgVariableSymbol* dev_thread_num_symbol = getFirstVarSym (dev_thread_num_decl);
1890  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_thread_num_symbol!= NULL);
1891 
1892  // int _dev_thread_id = getLoopIndexFromCUDAVariables(1);
1893  init_idx = buildAssignInitializer(buildFunctionCallExp(SgName("getLoopIndexFromCUDAVariables"), buildIntType(),buildExprListExp(buildIntVal(1)),bb1), buildIntType());
1894  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_thread_id_decl = buildVariableDeclaration("_dev_thread_id", buildIntType(), init_idx, bb1);
1895  appendStatement (dev_thread_id_decl, bb1);
1896  SgVariableSymbol* dev_thread_id_symbol = getFirstVarSym (dev_thread_id_decl);
1897  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_thread_id_symbol!= NULL);
1898 
1899  // initialize scheduler
1900  // XOMP_static_sched_init (orig_start, orig_end, orig_step, orig_chunk_size, _dev_thread_num, _dev_thread_id,
1901  // & _dev_loop_chunk_size , & _dev_loop_sched_index, & _dev_loop_stride);
1902  SgExprListExp* parameters = buildExprListExp(copyExpression (orig_lower), copyExpression (orig_upper), copyExpression(orig_stride), buildIntVal(1), buildVarRefExp(dev_thread_num_symbol), buildVarRefExp (dev_thread_id_symbol) );
1903  appendExpression (parameters, buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_chunk_size_decl))) );
1904  appendExpression (parameters, buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_sched_index_decl))) );
1905  appendExpression (parameters, buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_stride_decl))) );
1906  SgStatement* call_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt ("XOMP_static_sched_init", buildVoidType(), parameters, bb1);
1907  appendStatement (call_stmt, bb1);
1908 
1909  // function call exp as while (condition)
1910  // XOMP_static_sched_next (&_dev_loop_sched_index, orig_end, orig_step,_dev_loop_stride, _dev_loop_chunk_size,
1911  // _dev_thread_num, _dev_thread_id, & _dev_lower , & _dev_upper)
1912  parameters = buildExprListExp (buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_sched_index_decl))), copyExpression (orig_upper), copyExpression(orig_stride),buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_stride_decl)), buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_loop_chunk_size_decl)));
1913  appendExpression (parameters,buildVarRefExp(dev_thread_num_symbol));
1914  appendExpression (parameters,buildVarRefExp(dev_thread_id_symbol));
1915  appendExpression (parameters, buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_lower_decl))) );
1916  appendExpression (parameters, buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_upper_decl))) );
1917  SgExpression* func_call_exp = buildFunctionCallExp ("XOMP_static_sched_next", buildBoolType(), parameters, bb1);
1918 
1919  SgStatement* new_loop = deepCopy (for_loop);
1920  SgWhileStmt* w_stmt = buildWhileStmt (func_call_exp, new_loop);
1921  appendStatement (w_stmt, bb1);
1922 // moveStatementsBetweenBlocks (loop_body, isSgBasicBlock(w_stmt->get_body()));
1923 
1924  // rewrite upper, lower bounds, TODO how about step? normalized to 1 already ?
1925  setLoopLowerBound (new_loop, buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_lower_decl)));
1926  setLoopUpperBound (new_loop, buildVarRefExp (getFirstVarSym(dev_upper_decl)));
1927  removeStatement (for_loop);
1928 
1929 
1930 
1931  // handle private variables at this loop level, mostly loop index variables.
1932  // TODO: this is not very elegant since the outer most loop's loop variable is still translated.
1933  //for reduction
1934  per_block_declarations.clear(); // must reset to empty or wrong reference to stale content generated previously
1935  transOmpVariables(target, bb1,NULL, true);
1936 
1937  // Liao, 11/11/2014, clean up copied OmpAttribute
1938  if (new_loop->attributeExists("OmpAttributeList"))
1939  new_loop->removeAttribute("OmpAttributeList");
1940 #if 0
1941  AstAttributeMechanism* astAttributeContainer = new_loop ->get_attributeMechanism();
1942  if (astAttributeContainer != NULL)
1943  {
1944  for (AstAttributeMechanism::iterator i = astAttributeContainer->begin(); i != astAttributeContainer->end(); i++)
1945  {
1946  AstAttribute* attribute = i->second;

1950 #endif
1951 
1952 }

1975 // Parameters: SgNode* node: the OMP Parallel or OMP Parallel
1976 // std::string& wrapper_name: for C/C++, structure wrapper is used to wrap all parameters. This is to return the struct name
1977 // ASTtools::VarSymSet_t& syms : all variables to be passed in/out the outlined function
1978 // ASTtools::VarSymSet_t&pdSyms3 : variables which must be passed by references, used to guide the creation of struct wrapper: member using base type vs. using pointer type. The algorithm to generate this set is already very conservative: after transOmpVariables() , the only exclude firstprivate. In the context of OpenMP, it is equivalent to say this is a set of variables which are to be passed by references.
1979 // Algorithms:
1980 // Set flags of the outliner to indicate desired behaviors: parameter wrapping or not?
1981 // translate OpenMP variables (first private, private, reduction, etc) so the code to be outlined is already as simple as possible (without OpenMP-specific semantics)
1982 //
1983 // It calls the ROSE AST outliner internally.
1984 SgFunctionDeclaration* generateOutlinedTask(SgNode* node, std::string& wrapper_name, ASTtools::VarSymSet_t& syms, ASTtools::VarSymSet_t&pdSyms3)
1985 //SgFunctionDeclaration* generateOutlinedTask(SgNode* node, std::string& wrapper_name, ASTtools::VarSymSet_t& syms, std::set<SgInitializedName*>& readOnlyVars, ASTtools::VarSymSet_t&pdSyms3)
1986 {
1987  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
1988  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* target = isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(node);
1989  ROSE_ASSERT (target != NULL);
1990 
1991  // must be either omp task or omp parallel
1992  SgOmpTaskStatement* target1 = isSgOmpTaskStatement(node);
1993  SgOmpParallelStatement* target2 = isSgOmpParallelStatement(node);
1994  ROSE_ASSERT (target1 != NULL || target2 != NULL);
1995 
1996  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
1997  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
1998  SgFunctionDeclaration* result= NULL;
1999  //Initialize outliner
2000  Outliner::enable_classic = false; // we need use parameter wrapping, which is not classic behavior of outlining
2001  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language())
2002  {
2003  //We pass one variable per parameter, at least for Fortran 77
2004  Outliner::useParameterWrapper = false;
2005 // Outliner::enable_classic = true; // use subroutine's parameters directly
2006  }
2007  else
2008  {
2009  // C/C++ : always wrap parameters into a structure for outlining used during OpenMP translation
2010  Outliner::useParameterWrapper = true;
2011  Outliner::useStructureWrapper = true;
2012  }
2013 
2014  //TODO there should be some semantics check for the regions to be outlined
2015  //for example, multiple entries or exists are not allowed for OpenMP
2016  //This is however of low priority since most vendor compilers have this already.
2017  SgBasicBlock* body_block = Outliner::preprocess(body);
2018 
2019  //---------------------------------------------------------------
2020  // Key step: handling special variables BEFORE actual outlining is done!!
2021  // Variable handling is done after Outliner::preprocess() to ensure a basic block for the body,
2022  // but before calling the actual outlining
2023  // This simplifies the outlining since firstprivate, private variables are replaced
2024  //with their local copies before outliner is used
2025  transOmpVariables (target, body_block);
2026 
2027  // variable sets for private, firstprivate, reduction, and pointer dereferencing (pd)
2028  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t pSyms, fpSyms,reductionSyms, pdSyms;
2029 
2030  string func_name = Outliner::generateFuncName(target);
2031  SgGlobal* g_scope = SageInterface::getGlobalScope(body_block);
2032  ROSE_ASSERT(g_scope != NULL);
2033 
2034  //-----------------------------------------------------------------
2035  // Generic collection of variables to be passed as parameters of the outlined functions
2036  // semantically equivalent to shared variables in OpenMP
2037  Outliner::collectVars(body_block, syms);
2038 
2039  // Now decide on the parameter convention for all the parameters: pass-by-value vs. pass-by-reference (pointer dereferencing)
2040 
2041  // SageInterface::collectReadOnlyVariables(body_block,readOnlyVars);
2042  // We choose to be conservative about the variables needing pointer dereferencing first
2043  // AllParameters - readOnlyVars - private -firstprivate
2044  // Union ASTtools::collectPointerDereferencingVarSyms(body_block, pdSyms)
2045 
2046  // Assume all parameters need to be passed by reference/pointers first
2047  std::copy(syms.begin(), syms.end(), std::inserter(pdSyms,pdSyms.begin()));
2048 
2049  //exclude firstprivate variables: they are read only in fact
2050  //TODO keep class typed variables!!! even if they are firstprivate or private!!
2051  SgInitializedNamePtrList fp_vars = collectClauseVariables (target, V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause);
2052  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t fp_syms, pdSyms2;
2053  convertAndFilter (fp_vars, fp_syms);
2054  set_difference (pdSyms.begin(), pdSyms.end(),
2055  fp_syms.begin(), fp_syms.end(),
2056  std::inserter(pdSyms2, pdSyms2.begin()));
2057  // ROSE_ASSERT (pdSyms.size() == pdSyms2.size()); this means the previous set_difference is neccesary !
2058 
2059 #if 0
2060  // Similarly , exclude private variable, also read only
2061  // TODO: is this necessary? private variables should be handled already in transOmpVariables(). So Outliner::collectVars() will not collect them at all!
2062  SgInitializedNamePtrList p_vars = collectClauseVariables (target, V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
2063  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t p_syms; //, pdSyms3;
2064  convertAndFilter (p_vars, p_syms);
2065  //TODO keep class typed variables!!! even if they are firstprivate or private!!
2066  set_difference (pdSyms2.begin(), pdSyms2.end(),
2067  p_syms.begin(), p_syms.end(),
2068  std::inserter(pdSyms3, pdSyms3.begin()));
2069 
2070  ROSE_ASSERT (pdSyms2.size() == pdSyms3.size());
2071 #endif
2072  pdSyms3 = pdSyms2;
2073 
2074  // lastprivate and reduction variables cannot be excluded since write access to their shared copies
2075 
2076  // Sara Royuela 24/04/2012
2077  // When unpacking array variables in the outlined function, it is needed to have access to the size of the array.
2078  // When this size is a variable (or a operation containing variables), this variable must be added to the arguments of the outlined function.
2079  // Example:
2080  // Input snippet: Outlined function:
2081  // int N = 1; static void OUT__1__5493__(void *__out_argv) {
2082  // int a[N]; int (*a)[N] = (int (*)[N])(((struct OUT__1__5493___data *)__out_argv) -> a_p);
2083  // #pragma omp task shared(a) ( *a)[0] = 1;
2084  // a[0] = 1; }
2085  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t new_syms;
2086  for (ASTtools::VarSymSet_t::const_iterator i = syms.begin (); i != syms.end (); ++i)
2087  {
2088  SgType* i_type = (*i)->get_declaration()->get_type();
2089 
2090  while (isSgArrayType(i_type))
2091  {
2092  // Get most significant dimension
2093  SgExpression* index = ((SgArrayType*) i_type)->get_index();
2094 
2095  // Get the variables used to compute the dimension
2096  // FIXME We insert a new statement and delete it afterwards in order to use "collectVars" function

2476 void categorizeMapClauseVariables( const SgInitializedNamePtrList & all_vars, // all variables collected from map clauses
2477  std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > >& array_dimensions, // array bounds info
2478  std::set<SgSymbol*>& array_syms, // variable symbols which are array types (explicit or as a pointer)
2479  std::set<SgSymbol*>& atom_syms) // variable symbols which are non-aggregate types: scalar, pointer, etc
2480  {
2481  // categorize the variables:
2482  for (SgInitializedNamePtrList::const_iterator iter = all_vars.begin(); iter != all_vars.end(); iter ++)
2483  {
2484  SgInitializedName* i_name = *iter;
2485  ROSE_ASSERT (i_name != NULL);
2486 
2487  // In C/C++, an array can have a pointer type or SgArrayType.
2488  // We collect SgArrayType for sure. But for pointer type, we consult the array_dimension to decide.
2489  SgSymbol* sym = i_name ->get_symbol_from_symbol_table ();
2490  ROSE_ASSERT (sym != NULL);
2491  SgType * type = sym->get_type ();
2492  // TODO handle complex types like structure, typedef, cast, etc. here
2493  if (isSgArrayType(type))
2494  array_syms.insert (sym);
2495  else if (isSgPointerType(type))
2496  {
2497  if (array_dimensions[sym].size()!=0) // if we have bound information for the pointer type, it represents an array
2498  array_syms.insert (sym);
2499  else // otherwise a pointer pointing to non-array types
2500  atom_syms.insert (sym);
2501  }
2502  else if (isScalarType(type))
2503  {
2504  atom_syms.insert (sym);
2505  }
2506  else
2507  {
2508  cerr<<"Error. transOmpMapVariables() of omp_lowering.cpp: unhandled map clause variable type:"<<type->class_name()<<endl;
2509  }
2510  }
2511  // make sure the categorization is complete
2512  ROSE_ASSERT (all_vars.size() == (array_syms.size() + atom_syms.size()) );
2513  }

2556  // Check if a variable is in the clause's variable list
2557 bool isInClauseVariableList(SgOmpClause* cls, SgSymbol* var)
2558 {
2559  ROSE_ASSERT (cls && var);
2560  SgOmpVariablesClause* var_cls = isSgOmpVariablesClause(cls);
2561  ROSE_ASSERT (var_cls);
2562  SgExpressionPtrList refs = isSgOmpVariablesClause(var_cls)->get_variables()->get_expressions();
2563 
2564  std::vector<SgSymbol*> var_list;
2565  for (size_t j =0; j< refs.size(); j++)
2566  var_list.push_back(isSgVarRefExp(refs[j])->get_symbol());
2567 
2568  if (find(var_list.begin(), var_list.end(), var) != var_list.end() )
2569  return true;
2570  else
2571  return false;
2572 }

2577 //static int replaceVariableReferences(SgNode* subtree, const SgVariableSymbol* origin_sym, SgVariableSymbol* new_sym )
2578 static int replaceVariableReferences(SgNode* subtree, std::map <SgVariableSymbol*, SgVariableSymbol*> symbol_map)
2579 {
2580  int result = 0;
2581  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(subtree, V_SgVarRefExp);
2582  for (Rose_STL_Container<SgNode *>::iterator i = nodeList.begin(); i != nodeList.end(); i++)
2583  {

2602 {

2617 //TODO move to SageInterface
2618 // Liao 2/8/2013
2619 // rewrite array reference using multiple-dimension subscripts to a reference using one-dimension subscripts
2620 // e.g. a[i][j] is changed to a[i*col_size +j]
2621 // a [i][j][k] is changed to a [(i*col_size + j)*K_size +k]
2622 // The parameter is the array reference expression to be changed
2623 // Note the array reference expression must be the top one since there will be inner ones for a multi-dimensional array references in AST.
2624 static void linearizeArrayAccess(SgPntrArrRefExp* top_array_ref)
2625 {
2626  //Sanity check
2627  // TODO check language compatibility for C/C++ only: row major storage
2628  ROSE_ASSERT( top_array_ref != NULL);
2629  //ROSE_ASSERT (top_array_ref->get_lhs_operand_i() != NULL);
2630  ROSE_ASSERT (top_array_ref->get_parent() != NULL );
2631  ROSE_ASSERT (isSgPntrArrRefExp(top_array_ref->get_parent()) == NULL ); // top ==> must not be a child of a higher level array ref exp
2632 
2633  // must be a canonical array reference, not like (a+10)[10]
2634  SgExpression* arrayNameExp = NULL;
2635  std::vector<SgExpression*>* subscripts = new vector<SgExpression*>;
2636  bool is_array_ref = isArrayReference (top_array_ref, &arrayNameExp, &subscripts);
2637  ROSE_ASSERT (is_array_ref);
2638  SgInitializedName * i_name = convertRefToInitializedName(arrayNameExp);
2639  ROSE_ASSERT (i_name != NULL);
2640  SgType* var_type = i_name->get_type();
2641  SgArrayType * array_type = isSgArrayType(var_type);
2642  SgPointerType * pointer_type = isSgPointerType(var_type);
2643  // pointer type can also be used as pointer[i], which is represented as SgPntrArrRefExp.
2644  // In this case, we don't need to linearized it any more
2645  if (pointer_type != NULL)
2646  return;
2647  if (array_type == NULL)
2648  {
2649  cerr<<"Error. linearizeArrayAccess() found unhandled variable type:"<<var_type->class_name()<<endl;
2650  }
2651 
2652  ROSE_ASSERT (array_type!= NULL);
2653 
2654  std::vector <SgExpression*> dimensions ;
2655  getArrayDimensionSizes (array_type, dimensions);
2656 
2657  ROSE_ASSERT ((*subscripts).size() == dimensions.size());
2658  ROSE_ASSERT ((*subscripts).size()>1); // we only accept 2-D or above for processing. Caller should check this in advance
2659 
2660  // left hand operand
2661  SgExpression* new_lhs = buildVarRefExp(i_name);
2662  SgExpression* new_rhs = deepCopy((*subscripts)[0]); //initialized to be i;
2663 
2664  // build rhs, like (i*col_size + j)*K_size +k
2665  for (size_t i =1; i<dimensions.size(); i++) // only repeat dimension count -1 times
2666  {
2667  new_rhs = buildAddOp( buildMultiplyOp(new_rhs, deepCopy(dimensions[i]) ) , deepCopy((*subscripts)[i]) ) ;
2668  }
2669 
2670  // set new lhs and rhs for the top ref
2671  deepDelete(top_array_ref->get_lhs_operand_i()) ;
2672  deepDelete(top_array_ref->get_rhs_operand_i()) ;
2673 
2674  top_array_ref->set_lhs_operand_i(new_lhs);
2675  new_lhs->set_parent(top_array_ref);
2676 
2677  top_array_ref->set_rhs_operand_i(new_rhs);
2678  new_rhs->set_parent(top_array_ref);
2679 
2680 }
2681 
2682 
2683 // Find all top level array references within the body block,
2684 // we do the following:
2685 // if it is within the set of arrays (array_syms) to be rewritten: arrays on map() clause,
2686 // if it is more than 1-D
2687 // change it to be linearized subscript access
2688 static void rewriteArraySubscripts(SgBasicBlock* body_block, const std::set<SgSymbol*> mapped_array_syms)
2689 {
2690  std::vector<SgPntrArrRefExp* > candidate_refs; // store eligible references
2691  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(body_block, V_SgPntrArrRefExp);
2692  for (Rose_STL_Container<SgNode *>::iterator i = nodeList.begin(); i != nodeList.end(); i++)
2693  {
2694  SgPntrArrRefExp* vRef = isSgPntrArrRefExp((*i));
2695  ROSE_ASSERT (vRef != NULL);
2696  SgNode* parent = vRef->get_parent();
2697  // if it is top level ref?
2698  if (isSgPntrArrRefExp(parent)) // has a higher level array ref, skip it
2699  continue;
2700  //TODO: move this logic into a function in SageInterface
2701  // If it is a canonical array reference we can handle?
2702  vector<SgExpression *> *subscripts = new vector<SgExpression*>;
2703  SgExpression* array_name_exp = NULL;
2704  isArrayReference(vRef, &array_name_exp, &subscripts);
2705  SgInitializedName* a_name = convertRefToInitializedName (array_name_exp);
2706  if (a_name == NULL)
2707  continue;
2708  // if it is within the mapped array set?
2709  ROSE_ASSERT (a_name != NULL);
2710  SgSymbol* array_sym = a_name->get_symbol_from_symbol_table ();
2711  ROSE_ASSERT (array_sym != NULL);
2712 
2713  if (mapped_array_syms.find(array_sym)!= mapped_array_syms.end())
2714  candidate_refs.push_back(vRef);
2715  }
2716 
2717  // To be safe, we use reverse order iteration when changing them
2718  for (std::vector<SgPntrArrRefExp* >::reverse_iterator riter = candidate_refs.rbegin(); riter != candidate_refs.rend(); riter ++)
2719  {
2720  linearizeArrayAccess (*riter);
2721  }
2722 }

2792 // Translated a single mapped array variable, knowing the map clauses , where to insert, etc.
2793 // Only generate memory allocation, deallocation, copy, functions, not the declaration since decl involves too many variable bookkeeping.
2794 // This is intended to be called by a for loop going through all mapped array variables.
2795  // Essentially, we have to decide if we need to do the following steps for each variable
2796  //
2797  // Data handling: declaration, allocation, and copy
2798  // 1. declared a pointer type to the device copy : pass by pointer type vs. pass by value
2799  // 2. allocate device copy using the dimension bound info: for array types (pointers used for linearized arrays)
2800  // 3. copy the data from CPU to the device (GPU) copy:
2801  //
2802  // 4. replace references to the CPU copies with references to the GPU copy
2803  // 5. replace original multidimensional element indexing with linearized address indexing (for 2-D and more dimension arrays)
2804  //
2805  // Data handling: copy back, de-allocation
2806  // 6. copy GPU_copy back to CPU variables
2807  // 7. de-allocate the GPU variables
2808  //
2809  // Step 1,2,3 and 6, 7 should generate statements before or after the SgOmpTargetStatement
2810  // Step 4 and 5 should change the body of the affected SgOmpParallelStatement
2811  // Revised Algorithm (version 3) 1/23/2015, optionally use device data environment (DDE) functions to manage data automatically.
2812  // Instead of generate explicit data allocation, copy, free functions, using the following three DDE functions:
2813  // 1. xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentEnter()
2814  // 2. xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentPrepareVariable ()
2815  // 3. xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentExit()
2816  // This is necessary to have a consistent translation for mapped data showing up in both "target data" and "target" directives.
2817  // These DDE functions internally will keep track of data allocated and try to reuse enclosing data environment.
2818 static void generateMappedArrayMemoryHandling(
2819  /* the array and the map information */
2820  SgSymbol* sym,
2821  SgOmpMapClause* map_alloc_clause, SgOmpMapClause* map_to_clause, SgOmpMapClause* map_from_clause, SgOmpMapClause* map_tofrom_clause,
2822  std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > > & array_dimensions, SgExpression* device_expression,
2823  /*Where to insert generated function calls*/
2824  SgBasicBlock* insertion_scope, SgStatement* insertion_anchor_stmt,
2825  bool need_generate_data_stmt
2826  )
2827 {
2828  ROSE_ASSERT (sym != NULL);
2829  ROSE_ASSERT (device_expression!= NULL); // runtime now needs explicit device ID to work
2830  SgType* orig_type = sym->get_type();
2831 
2832  // Step 1: declare a pointer type to array variables in map clauses, we linearize all arrays to be a 1-D pointer
2833  // Element_type * _dev_var;
2834  // e.g.: double* _dev_array;
2835  // I believe that all array variables need allocations on GPUs, regardless their map operations (alloc, to, from, or tofrom)
2836 
2837  // TODO: is this a safe assumption here??
2838  SgType* element_type = orig_type->findBaseType(); // recursively strip away non-base type to get the bottom type
2839  string orig_name = (sym->get_name()).getString();
2840  string dev_var_name = "_dev_"+ orig_name;
2841 
2842  // Step 2.1 generate linear size calculation based on array dimension info
2843  // int dev_array_size = sizeof (double) *dim_size1 * dim_size2;
2844  string dev_var_size_name = "_dev_" + orig_name + "_size";
2845  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_var_size_decl = NULL;
2846 
2847  SgVariableSymbol* dev_var_size_sym = insertion_scope->lookup_variable_symbol(dev_var_size_name);
2848  std::vector<SgExpression*> v_size;
2849  int dimSize = 0;
2850  if (dev_var_size_sym == NULL)
2851  {
2852 // SgExpression* initializer = generateSizeCalculationExpression (sym, element_type, array_dimensions[sym]);
2853  SgExprListExp* initializer = buildExprListExp();
2854  if(array_dimensions[sym].size() > 0){
2855  dimSize = array_dimensions[sym].size();
2856  for (std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> >::const_iterator iter = array_dimensions[sym].begin(); iter != array_dimensions[sym].end(); iter++)
2857  {
2858  std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> bound_pair = *iter;
2859  initializer->append_expression(deepCopy(bound_pair.second));
2860  v_size.push_back(deepCopy(bound_pair.second));
2861  }
2862  }
2863  else
2864  {
2865  ROSE_ASSERT (sym!= NULL);
2866  SgArrayType* a_type = isSgArrayType (orig_type);
2867  ROSE_ASSERT (a_type!= NULL);
2868  std::vector< SgExpression * > dims = get_C_array_dimensions (a_type);
2869  for (std::vector < SgExpression* >::const_iterator iter = dims.begin(); iter != dims.end(); iter++)
2870  {
2871  SgExpression* length_exp = *iter;
2872  //TODO: get_C_array_dimensions returns one extra null expression somehow.
2873  if (!isSgNullExpression(length_exp))
2874  {
2875  dimSize++;
2876  initializer->append_expression(deepCopy(length_exp));
2877  v_size.push_back(deepCopy(length_exp));
2878  }
2879  }
2880  }
2881  dev_var_size_decl = buildVariableDeclaration (dev_var_size_name, buildArrayType(buildIntType(),buildIntVal(dimSize)), buildAggregateInitializer(initializer), insertion_scope);
2882  insertStatementBefore (insertion_anchor_stmt, dev_var_size_decl);
2883  }
2884  else
2885  dev_var_size_decl = isSgVariableDeclaration(dev_var_size_sym->get_declaration()->get_declaration());
2886 
2887  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_var_size_decl != NULL);
2888

2890  // generate offset array
2891  string dev_var_offset_name = "_dev_" + orig_name + "_offset";
2892  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_var_offset_decl = NULL;
2893 
2894  SgVariableSymbol* dev_var_offset_sym = insertion_scope->lookup_variable_symbol(dev_var_offset_name);

2898  {

2911  {
2912  arrayInitializer->append_expression(buildIntVal(0));
2913  v_offset.push_back(buildIntVal(0));

2915  }

2918  }
2919  else

2921 
2922  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_var_offset_decl != NULL);
2923 
2924  offload_array_offset_map[dev_var_name] = v_offset;
2925 
2926  // generate Dim array
2927  string dev_var_Dim_name = "_dev_" + orig_name + "_Dim";
2928  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_var_Dim_decl = NULL;
2929 
2930  SgVariableSymbol* dev_var_Dim_sym = insertion_scope->lookup_variable_symbol(dev_var_Dim_name);
2931  std::vector<SgExpression*> v_dimSize;
2932  if (dev_var_Dim_sym == NULL)
2933  {
2934  SgExprListExp* arrayInitializer = buildExprListExp();
2935  {
2936  ROSE_ASSERT (sym!= NULL);
2937  SgArrayType* a_type = isSgArrayType (orig_type);
2938  if(a_type != NULL){
2939  std::vector< SgExpression * > dims = get_C_array_dimensions (a_type);
2940  for (std::vector < SgExpression* >::const_iterator iter = dims.begin(); iter != dims.end(); iter++)
2941  {
2942  SgExpression* length_exp = *iter;
2943  //TODO: get_C_array_dimensions returns one extra null expression somehow.
2944  if (!isSgNullExpression(length_exp))
2945  {
2946  arrayInitializer->append_expression(deepCopy(length_exp));
2947  v_dimSize.push_back(deepCopy(length_exp));
2948  }
2949  }
2950  }
2951  else
2952  {
2953  for (int i=0; i < dimSize; ++i)
2954  {
2955  arrayInitializer->append_expression(deepCopy(v_size[i]));
2956  v_dimSize.push_back(deepCopy(v_size[i]));
2957  }
2958  }
2959  }
2960  dev_var_Dim_decl = buildVariableDeclaration (dev_var_Dim_name, buildArrayType(buildIntType(),buildIntVal(dimSize)), buildAggregateInitializer(arrayInitializer), insertion_scope);
2961  insertStatementBefore (insertion_anchor_stmt, dev_var_Dim_decl);
2962  }

2964  dev_var_Dim_decl = isSgVariableDeclaration(dev_var_Dim_sym->get_declaration()->get_declaration());
2965 
2966  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_var_Dim_decl != NULL);
2967  offload_array_size_map[dev_var_name] = v_dimSize;
2968 
2969  // Only if we are in the mode of inserting data handling statements
2970  if (!need_generate_data_stmt)
2971  return;
2972 
2973  bool needCopyTo = false;
2974  bool needCopyFrom = false;
2975  if ( ((map_to_clause) && (isInClauseVariableList (map_to_clause,sym))) ||
2976  ((map_tofrom_clause) && (isInClauseVariableList (map_tofrom_clause,sym))) )
2977  needCopyTo = true;
2978 
2979  if (( (map_from_clause) && (isInClauseVariableList (map_from_clause,sym))) ||
2980  ( (map_tofrom_clause) && (isInClauseVariableList (map_tofrom_clause,sym))))

2985  // a single function call does all things transparently: reuse first, if not then allocation, copy data

2987  SgExpression* copyToExp= NULL;
2988  SgExpression* copyFromExp = NULL;
2989  if (needCopyTo) copyToExp = buildBoolValExp(1);
2990  else copyToExp = buildBoolValExp(0);
2991 
2992  if (needCopyFrom) copyFromExp = buildBoolValExp(1);
2993  else copyFromExp = buildBoolValExp(0);
2994

2996  preservedHostVarRefs.insert (host_var_ref);

2998 
2999  SgExprListExp * parameters =
3000  buildExprListExp(device_expression, buildCastExp( host_var_ref, buildPointerType(buildVoidType()) ),buildIntVal(dimSize),buildSizeOfOp(element_type),

3007  buildPointerType(buildVoidType()),

3033  if (needCopyTo)
3034  {
3035  SgExprListExp * parameters = buildExprListExp (
3036  buildCastExp(buildVarRefExp(dev_var_name, insertion_scope), buildPointerType(buildVoidType())),
3037  buildCastExp(buildVarRefExp(orig_name, insertion_scope), buildPointerType(buildConstType(buildVoidType())) ),
3038  buildVarRefExp(dev_var_size_name, insertion_scope)
3039  );
3040  SgExprStatement* mem_copy_to_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt (SgName("xomp_memcpyHostToDevice"),
3041  buildPointerType(buildVoidType()),
3042  parameters,
3043  insertion_scope);
3044  insertStatementBefore (insertion_anchor_stmt, mem_copy_to_stmt);
3045  }
3046  }
3047 
3048  if (useDDE)
3049  { // call xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentExit() and it will automatically copy back data and deallocate.
3050  //SgExprStatement* dde_exit_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt (SgName("xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentExit"), buildVoidType(), NULL, insertion_scope);
3051  // appendStatement(dde_exit_stmt , insertion_anchor_stmt->get_scope());
3052  // do nothing here or we will get multiple exit() for a single DDE.
3053  }
3054  else
3055  { // or explicitly control copy back and deallocation
3056  // Step 6. copy back data from GPU to CPU, only for variable in map(out:var_list)
3057  // e.g. xomp_memcpyDeviceToHost ((void*)c, (const void*)dev_m3, array_size);
3058  // Note: insert this AFTER the target directive stmt
3059  // SgStatement* prev_stmt = target_parallel_stmt;
3060  if (needCopyFrom)
3061  {
3062  SgExprListExp * parameters = buildExprListExp (
3063  buildCastExp(buildVarRefExp(orig_name, insertion_scope), buildPointerType(buildVoidType()) ),
3064  buildCastExp(buildVarRefExp(dev_var_name, insertion_scope), buildPointerType(buildConstType(buildVoidType()))),
3065  buildVarRefExp( dev_var_size_name, insertion_scope)
3066  );
3067  SgExprStatement* mem_copy_back_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt (SgName("xomp_memcpyDeviceToHost"),
3068  buildPointerType(buildVoidType()),
3069  parameters,
3070  insertion_scope);
3071  appendStatement(mem_copy_back_stmt, insertion_anchor_stmt->get_scope());
3072  // prev_stmt = mem_copy_back_stmt;
3073  }
3074 
3075  // Step 7, de-allocate GPU memory
3076  // e.g. xomp_freeDevice(dev_m1);
3077  // Note: insert this AFTER the target directive stmt or the copy back stmt
3078  SgExprStatement* mem_dealloc_stmt =
3079  buildFunctionCallStmt(SgName("xomp_freeDevice"),
3080  buildBoolType(),
3081  buildExprListExp(buildVarRefExp( dev_var_name,insertion_scope)),
3082  insertion_scope);
3083  appendStatement(mem_dealloc_stmt, insertion_anchor_stmt->get_scope());
3084  }
3085 }

3087 // trans OpenMP map variables
3088 // return all generated or remaining variables to be passed to the outliner
3089  // Liao, 2/4/2013
3090  // Translate the map clause variables associated with "omp target parallel"
3091  // We only support combined "target parallel" or "parallel" immediately following "target"
3092  // So we handle outlining and data handling for two directives at the same time
3093  // TODO: move to the header
3094  // Input:
3095  //
3096  // map(alloc|to|from|tofrom:var_list)
3097  // array variable in var_list should have dimension bounds information like [0:N-1][0:K-1]
3098  //
3099  // Essentially, we have to decide if we need to do the following steps for each variable
3100  //
3101  // Data handling: declaration, allocation, and copy
3102  // 1. declared a pointer type to the device copy : pass by pointer type vs. pass by value
3103  // 2. allocate device copy using the dimension bound info: for array types (pointers used for linearized arrays)
3104  // 3. copy the data from CPU to the device (GPU) copy:
3105  //
3106  // 4. replace references to the CPU copies with references to the GPU copy
3107  // 5. replace original multidimensional element indexing with linearized address indexing (for 2-D and more dimension arrays)
3108  //
3109  // Data handling: copy back, de-allocation
3110  // 6. copy GPU_copy back to CPU variables
3111  // 7. de-allocate the GPU variables
3112  //
3113  // Step 1,2,3 and 6, 7 should generate statements before or after the SgOmpTargetStatement
3114  // Step 4 and 5 should change the body of the affected SgOmpParallelStatement
3115  //
3116  // Algorithm 1:
3117  // collect all variables in map clauses: they should be either scalar or arrays with bound info.
3118  // For each array variable,
3119  // we generate memory handling statements for them: declaration, allocation, copy back-forth, de-allocation
3120  // For the use of array variable,
3121  // we replace the original references with references to new pointer typed variables
3122  // Linearize the access when 2-D or more dimensions are used.
3123  //
3124  // Based on the mapped variables, we output the variables to be passed to the outlined function to be generated later on
3125  // variables which will be passed by their original data types
3126  // variables which will be passed by their address of type: pointer type pointing to their original data type
3127  //
3128  // Revised Algorithm (version 2): To translate "omp target" + "omp parallel for" enclosed within "omp target data" region:
3129  // New facts:
3130  // the map clauses are now associated with "omp target data" instead of "omp target"
3131  // Only a subset of all mapped variables at "omp target data" level will be used within "omp target":
3132  // a single data region contains multiple "omp target" regions
3133  // When translating "omp target" + "omp parallel for", we don't need to generate data handling statements
3134  // but we need to refer to the declarations for device variables.
3135  // Memory declaration, allocation, copy back-forth, de-allocation is generated within the body of the "omp target data" region.
3136  // we can still try to generate them when translating "omp parallel for" under "omp target", if not yet generated before.
3137  //
3138  // Revised Algorithm (V3): using Device Data Environment (DDE) runtime support to manage nested data regions
3139  // To simplify the handling, we assume
3140  // 1. Both "target data" and "target parallel for " should have map() clauses
3141  // 2. Using DDE, the translation is simplified as is identical for both directive
3142 ASTtools::VarSymSet_t transOmpMapVariables(SgStatement* target_data_or_target_parallel_stmt // either "target data" or "target parallel" statement
3143  )
3144 {
3145  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t all_syms;
3146  ROSE_ASSERT (target_data_or_target_parallel_stmt !=NULL);
3147  ROSE_ASSERT (all_syms.size() == 0); // it should be empty
3148 
3149  SgOmpParallelStatement* target_parallel_stmt = NULL;
3150  SgOmpTargetStatement* target_directive_stmt = NULL;
3151  SgOmpTargetDataStatement * target_data_stmt = NULL;
3152 
3153 
3154  target_parallel_stmt = isSgOmpParallelStatement(target_data_or_target_parallel_stmt);
3155  target_data_stmt = isSgOmpTargetDataStatement(target_data_or_target_parallel_stmt);
3156 
3157  // the parallel directive must be combined with target directive
3158  if (target_parallel_stmt != NULL)
3159  {
3160  // must be a parallel region directly under "omp target"
3161  SgNode* parent = target_parallel_stmt->get_parent();
3162  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);
3163  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent)) //skip the possible block in between
3164  parent = parent->get_parent();
3165  target_directive_stmt = isSgOmpTargetStatement(parent);
3166  ROSE_ASSERT (target_directive_stmt != NULL);
3167  }
3168 
3169  // collect map clauses and their variables
3170  // ----------------------------------------------------------
3171  // Some notes for the relevant AST input:
3172  // we store a map clause for each variant/operator (alloc, to, from, and tofrom), so there should be up to 4 SgOmpMapClause.
3173  // SgOmpClause::omp_map_operator_enum
3174  // each map clause has
3175  // a variable list (SgVarRefExp), accessible through get_variables()
3176  // a pointer to array_dimensions, accessible through get_array_dimensions(). the array_dimensions is identical among all map clause of a same "omp target"
3177  // std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > > array_dimensions
3178 
3179  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> map_clauses;
3180  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> device_clauses;
3181  if (target_data_stmt)
3182  {
3183  map_clauses = getClause(target_data_stmt, V_SgOmpMapClause);
3184  device_clauses = getClause(target_data_stmt, V_SgOmpDeviceClause);
3185  }
3186  else if (target_directive_stmt)
3187  {
3188  map_clauses = getClause(target_directive_stmt, V_SgOmpMapClause);
3189  device_clauses = getClause(target_directive_stmt, V_SgOmpDeviceClause);
3190  }
3191  else
3192  {
3193  ROSE_ABORT ();
3194  }
3195 
3196  if ( map_clauses.size() == 0) return all_syms; // stop if no map clauses at all
3197 
3198  // store each time of map clause explicitly
3199  SgOmpMapClause* map_alloc_clause = NULL;
3200  SgOmpMapClause* map_to_clause = NULL;
3201  SgOmpMapClause* map_from_clause = NULL;
3202  SgOmpMapClause* map_tofrom_clause = NULL;
3203  // dimension map is the same for all the map clauses under the same omp target directive
3204  std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > > array_dimensions;
3205  std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector< std::pair< SgOmpClause::omp_map_dist_data_enum, SgExpression * > > > dist_data_policies; // no in use, for compatible reason
3206 
3207  // a map between original symbol and its device version : used for variable replacement
3208  std::map <SgVariableSymbol*, SgVariableSymbol*> cpu_gpu_var_map;
3209 
3210  // store all variables showing up in any of the map clauses
3211  SgInitializedNamePtrList all_mapped_vars ;
3212  if (target_data_stmt)
3213  all_mapped_vars = collectClauseVariables (target_data_stmt, VariantVector(V_SgOmpMapClause));
3214  else if (target_directive_stmt)
3215  all_mapped_vars = collectClauseVariables (target_directive_stmt, VariantVector(V_SgOmpMapClause));
3216 
3217  // store all variables showing up in any of the device clauses
3218  SgExpression* device_expression = NULL;
3219  if (target_data_stmt)
3220  device_expression = getClauseExpression (target_data_stmt, VariantVector(V_SgOmpDeviceClause));
3221  else if (target_directive_stmt)
3222  device_expression = getClauseExpression (target_directive_stmt, VariantVector(V_SgOmpDeviceClause));
3223 
3224  extractMapClauses (map_clauses, array_dimensions, dist_data_policies, &map_alloc_clause, &map_to_clause, &map_from_clause, &map_tofrom_clause);
3225  std::set<SgSymbol*> array_syms; // store clause variable symbols which are array types (explicit or as a pointer)
3226  std::set<SgSymbol*> atom_syms; // store clause variable symbols which are non-aggregate types: scalar, pointer, etc
3227 
3228  // categorize the variables:
3229  categorizeMapClauseVariables (all_mapped_vars, array_dimensions, array_syms, atom_syms);
3230 
3231  // set the scope and anchor statement we will focus on based on the availability of an enclosing target data region
3232  SgBasicBlock* insertion_scope = NULL; // the body
3233  SgStatement* insertion_anchor_stmt = NULL; // the single statement within the body
3234  if (target_data_stmt != NULL)
3235  {
3236  // at this point, the body should already be normalized to be a BB
3237  SgBasicBlock * body_block = ensureBasicBlockAsBodyOfOmpBodyStmt(target_data_stmt);
3238  ROSE_ASSERT (body_block!= NULL);
3239 
3240  SgStatement* target_data_child_stmt = NULL;
3241  // We cannot assert this since the body of "omp target data" may already be expanded as part of a previous translation
3242  // ROSE_ASSERT( (target_data_stmt_body->get_statements()).size() ==1);
3243  target_data_child_stmt = (body_block->get_statements())[0];
3244 
3245  insertion_scope = body_block;
3246  insertion_anchor_stmt = target_data_child_stmt;
3247  }
3248  else if (target_directive_stmt != NULL)
3249  {
3250  insertion_scope= isSgBasicBlock(target_directive_stmt->get_body());
3251  insertion_anchor_stmt = target_parallel_stmt;
3252  }
3253 
3254  ROSE_ASSERT (insertion_scope!= NULL);
3255  ROSE_ASSERT (insertion_anchor_stmt!= NULL);
3256 
3257  // collect used variables in the insertion scope
3258  std::map <SgVariableSymbol *, bool> variable_map = collectVariableAppearance (insertion_scope);
3259 
3260  // Now insert xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentEnter() before xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentPrepareVariable()
3261  SgExprListExp* argumentList = NULL;
3262  if(device_expression)
3263  {
3264  argumentList = buildExprListExp(deepCopy(device_expression));
3265  }
3266  else // use default device ID 0 if device_expression is NULL
3267  {
3268  device_expression = buildIntVal(0);
3269  argumentList = buildExprListExp(device_expression);
3270  }
3271 
3272  SgExprStatement* dde_enter_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt (SgName("xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentEnter"), buildVoidType(), argumentList, insertion_scope);
3273  prependStatement(dde_enter_stmt, insertion_scope);
3274 
3275  // handle array variables showing up in the map clauses:
3276  for (std::set<SgSymbol*>::const_iterator iter = array_syms.begin(); iter != array_syms.end(); iter ++)
3277  {
3278  SgSymbol* sym = *iter;
3279  ROSE_ASSERT (sym != NULL);
3280  SgType* orig_type = sym->get_type();
3281 
3282  // Step 1: declare a pointer type to array variables in map clauses, we linearize all arrays to be a 1-D pointer
3283  // Element_type * _dev_var;
3284  // e.g.: double* _dev_array;
3285  // I believe that all array variables need allocations on GPUs, regardless their map operations (alloc, to, from, or tofrom)
3286 
3287  // TODO: is this a safe assumption here??
3288  SgType* element_type = orig_type->findBaseType(); // recursively strip away non-base type to get the bottom type
3289  string orig_name = (sym->get_name()).getString();
3290  string dev_var_name = "_dev_"+ orig_name;
3291 
3292  SgVariableDeclaration* dev_var_decl = NULL;
3293  dev_var_decl = buildVariableDeclaration(dev_var_name, buildPointerType(element_type), NULL, insertion_scope);
3294  insertStatementBefore (insertion_anchor_stmt, dev_var_decl);
3295  ROSE_ASSERT (dev_var_decl != NULL);
3296 
3297  SgVariableSymbol* orig_sym = isSgVariableSymbol(sym);
3298  ROSE_ASSERT (orig_sym != NULL);
3299  SgVariableSymbol* new_sym = getFirstVarSym(dev_var_decl);
3300  cpu_gpu_var_map[orig_sym]= new_sym; // store the mapping, this is always needed to guide the outlining
3301 
3302  // Not all map variables from "omp target data" will be used within the current parallel region
3303  // We only need to find out the used one only.
3304 
3305  // linearized array pointers should be directly passed to the outliner later on, without adding & operator in front of them
3306  // we assume AST is normalized and all target regions have explicit and correct map() clauses
3307  // Still some transformation like loop collapse will change the variables
3308  if (variable_map[orig_sym])
3309  all_syms.insert(new_sym);
3310  // generate memory allocation, copy, free function calls.
3311  generateMappedArrayMemoryHandling (sym, map_alloc_clause, map_to_clause, map_from_clause, map_tofrom_clause,array_dimensions, device_expression,
3312  insertion_scope, insertion_anchor_stmt, true);
3313  } // end for
3314 
3315  // Generate a single DDE enter() call
3316  SgExprStatement* dde_exit_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt (SgName("xomp_deviceDataEnvironmentExit"), buildVoidType(), argumentList, insertion_scope);
3317  appendStatement(dde_exit_stmt , insertion_anchor_stmt->get_scope());
3318 
3319  // Step 5. TODO replace indexing element access with address calculation (only needed for 2/3 -D)
3320  // We switch the order of 4 and 5 since we want to rewrite the subscripts before the arrays are replaced
3321  rewriteArraySubscripts (insertion_scope, array_syms);
3322 
3323  // Step 4. replace references to old with new variables,
3324  replaceVariableReferences (insertion_scope , cpu_gpu_var_map);
3325 
3326  // TODO handle scalar, separate or merged into previous loop ?
3327 
3328  // store remaining variables so outliner can readily use this information
3329  // for pointers to linearized arrays, they should passed by their original form, not using & operator, regardless the map operator types (to|from|alloc|tofrom)
3330  // for a scalar, two cases: to vs. from | tofrom
3331  // if in only, pass by value is good
3332  // if either from or tofrom:
3333  // two possible solutions:
3334  // 1) we need to treat it as an array of size 1 or any other choices. TODO!!
3335  // we also have to replace the reference to scalar to the array element access: be cautious about using by value (a) vs. using by address (&a)
3336  // 2) try to still pass by value, but copy the final value back to the CPU version
3337  // right now we assume they are not on from|tofrom, until we face a real input applications with map(from:scalar_a)
3338  // For all scalars, we directly copy them into all_syms for now
3339  for (std::set<SgSymbol*> ::iterator iter = atom_syms.begin(); iter != atom_syms.end(); iter ++)
3340  {
3341  SgVariableSymbol * var_sym = isSgVariableSymbol(*iter);
3342  if (variable_map[var_sym] == true) // we should only collect map variables which show up in the current parallel region
3343  all_syms.insert (var_sym);
3344  }
3345 
3346  //Pei-Hung: subtract offset from the subscript in the offloaded array reference
3347  if(target_parallel_stmt)
3348  {
3349  // at this point, the body must be a BB now.
3350  SgBasicBlock* body_block = isSgBasicBlock(target_parallel_stmt->get_body()); // the body of the affected "omp parallel"
3351  ROSE_ASSERT (body_block!= NULL);
3352  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(body_block, V_SgVarRefExp);
3353  for (Rose_STL_Container<SgNode *>::iterator i = nodeList.begin(); i != nodeList.end(); i++)
3354  {
3355  SgVarRefExp *vRef = isSgVarRefExp((*i));
3356  SgVariableSymbol* sym = vRef->get_symbol();
3357  SgType* type = sym->get_type();
3358  if(offload_array_offset_map.find(vRef->get_symbol()->get_name().getString()) != offload_array_offset_map.end())
3359  {
3360  std::vector<SgExpression*> v_offset = offload_array_offset_map.find(vRef->get_symbol()->get_name().getString())->second;
3361  std::vector<SgExpression*> v_size = offload_array_size_map.find(vRef->get_symbol()->get_name().getString())->second;
3362  if(isSgPntrArrRefExp(vRef->get_parent()) == NULL)
3363  continue;
3364  //std::cout << "finding susbscript " << vRef->get_symbol()->get_name().getString() << " in " << offload_array_offset_map.size() << std::endl;
3365  SgPntrArrRefExp* pntrArrRef = isSgPntrArrRefExp(vRef->get_parent());
3366  std::vector<SgExpression*> arrayType =get_C_array_dimensions(type);
3367  //std::cout << "vector size = " << v_offset.size() << " array dim= " << arrayType.size() << std::endl;
3368  if(v_offset.size() == arrayType.size())
3369  {
3370  for(std::vector<SgExpression*>::reverse_iterator ir = v_offset.rbegin(); ir != v_offset.rend(); ir++)
3371  {
3372  ROSE_ASSERT(pntrArrRef);
3373  SgExpression* subscript = pntrArrRef->get_rhs_operand();
3374  SgExpression* newsubscript = buildSubtractOp(deepCopy(subscript),deepCopy(*ir));
3375  replaceExpression(subscript,newsubscript,true);
3376  pntrArrRef = isSgPntrArrRefExp(pntrArrRef->get_parent());
3377  }
3378  }
3379  // collapsed case
3380  else
3381  {
3382  ROSE_ASSERT(pntrArrRef);
3383  SgExpression* subscript = pntrArrRef->get_rhs_operand();
3384  SgExpression* newsubscript = deepCopy(subscript);
3385  std::vector<SgExpression*>::reverse_iterator irsize = v_size.rbegin();
3386  for(std::vector<SgExpression*>::reverse_iterator ir = v_offset.rbegin(); ir != v_offset.rend(); ir++)
3387  {
3388  SgIntVal* intVal = isSgIntVal(*ir);
3389  if(intVal && intVal->get_value() == 0)
3390  {
3391  irsize++;
3392  continue;
3393  }
3394  if(ir ==v_offset.rbegin())
3395  newsubscript = buildSubtractOp(newsubscript,deepCopy(*ir));
3396  else
3397  newsubscript = buildSubtractOp(newsubscript,buildMultiplyOp(deepCopy(*ir),deepCopy(*irsize)));
3398  irsize++;
3399  }
3400  replaceExpression(subscript,newsubscript,true);
3401  }
3402  }
3403  }
3404  }
3405  return all_syms;
3406 } // end transOmpMapVariables() for omp target data's map clauses for now
