3409 // old version: kept to occasionally see previous translation results.
3410 // generating explicit data handling function calls
3411  void transOmpMapVariables_v1(
3412  SgOmpParallelStatement* target_parallel_stmt, //the "omp parallel" with enclosing "omp target", or combined "target parallel"
3413  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t & all_syms // collect all generated or remaining variables to be passed to the outliner
3414  )
3415  {
3416  ROSE_ASSERT (target_parallel_stmt!= NULL);
3417 
3418  // must be a parallel region directly under "omp target"
3419  SgNode* parent = target_parallel_stmt->get_parent();
3420  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);
3421  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent)) //skip the possible block in between
3422  parent = parent->get_parent();
3423  SgOmpTargetStatement* target_directive_stmt = isSgOmpTargetStatement(parent);
3424  ROSE_ASSERT (target_directive_stmt != NULL);
3425 
3426  // at this point, the body must be a BB now.
3427  SgBasicBlock* body_block = isSgBasicBlock(target_parallel_stmt->get_body()); // the body of the affected "omp parallel"
3428  ROSE_ASSERT (body_block!= NULL);
3429  // we should use inner scope , instead of the scope of target-directive-stmt.
3430  // this will avoid name collisions when there are multiple "omp target" within one big scope
3431  SgScopeStatement* target_directive_body = isSgScopeStatement(target_directive_stmt->get_body());
3432  ROSE_ASSERT (target_directive_body != NULL);
3433  ROSE_ASSERT (isSgBasicBlock (target_directive_body));
3434 
3435  std::map <SgVariableSymbol *, bool> variable_map = collectVariableAppearance (target_parallel_stmt);
3436 #if 1
3437  // two cases: map variables are provided by
3438  // case 1: "omp target"
3439  // case 2: "omp target data"
3440  // we have to figure which case is true for the current affected "omp parallel"
3441  SgOmpTargetDataStatement* target_data_stmt = getEnclosingNode <SgOmpTargetDataStatement> (target_directive_stmt);
3442  SgBasicBlock * target_data_stmt_body = NULL;
3443  SgStatement* target_data_child_stmt = NULL;
3444  if (!useDDE) // only in the old, explicit data management mode, we translate map variables differently depending on context
3445  if (target_data_stmt != NULL)
3446  {
3447  target_data_stmt_body = ensureBasicBlockAsBodyOfOmpBodyStmt (target_data_stmt);
3448  ROSE_ASSERT (target_data_stmt_body != NULL);
3449  // We cannot assert this since the body of "omp target data" may already be expanded as part of a previous translation
3450  // ROSE_ASSERT( (target_data_stmt_body->get_statements()).size() ==1);
3451  target_data_child_stmt = (target_data_stmt_body->get_statements())[0];
3452  }
3453 #endif
3454  // collect map clauses and their variables
3455  // ----------------------------------------------------------
3456  // Some notes for the relevant AST input:
3457  // we store a map clause for each variant/operator (alloc, to, from, and tofrom), so there should be up to 4 SgOmpMapClause.
3458  // SgOmpClause::omp_map_operator_enum
3459  // each map clause has
3460  // a variable list (SgVarRefExp), accessible through get_variables()
3461  // a pointer to array_dimensions, accessible through get_array_dimensions(). the array_dimensions is identical among all map clause of a same "omp target"
3462  // std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > > array_dimensions
3463  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> map_clauses;
3464 #if 1
3465  if (target_data_stmt != NULL && !useDDE)
3466  {
3467  map_clauses = getClause(target_data_stmt, V_SgOmpMapClause);
3468  }
3469  else
3470 #endif
3471  map_clauses = getClause(target_directive_stmt, V_SgOmpMapClause);
3472 
3473  if ( map_clauses.size() == 0) return; // stop if no map clauses at all
3474 
3475  // store each time of map clause explicitly
3476  SgOmpMapClause* map_alloc_clause = NULL;
3477  SgOmpMapClause* map_to_clause = NULL;
3478  SgOmpMapClause* map_from_clause = NULL;
3479  SgOmpMapClause* map_tofrom_clause = NULL;
3480  // dimension map is the same for all the map clauses under the same omp target directive
3481  std::map<SgSymbol*, std::vector < std::pair <SgExpression*, SgExpression*> > > array_dimensions;

3879  /*
3880  * Expected AST layout:
3881  * SgOmpSectionsStatement
3882  * SgBasicBlock
3883  * SgOmpSectionStatement (1 or more section statements here)
3884  * SgBasicBlock
3885  * SgStatement
3886  *
3887  * Example translated code:
3888  int _section_1 = XOMP_sections_init_next (3);
3889  while (_section_1 >=0) // This while loop is a must
3890  {
3891  switch (_section_1) {
3892  case 0:
3893  printf("hello from section 1\n");
3894  break;
3895  case 1:
3896  printf("hello from section 2\n");
3897  break;
3898  case 2:
3899  printf("hello from section 3\n");
3900  break;
3901  default:
3902  printf("fatal error: XOMP_sections_?_next() returns illegal value %d\n", _section_1);
3903  abort();
3904  }
3905  _section_1 = XOMP_sections_next (); // next round for the current thread: deal with possible number of threads < number of sections
3906  }
3907 
3908  XOMP_sections_end(); // Or XOMP_sections_end_nowait ();
3909  * */
3910  void transOmpSections(SgNode* node)
3911  {
3912 // cout<<"Entering transOmpSections() ..."<<endl;

4057  /*
4058  The translation of omp task is similar to the one for omp parallel
4059  Please remember to call patchUpFirstprivateVariables() before this function to make implicit firstprivate
4060  variables explicit.
4061 
4062  The gomp runtime function for omp task is:
4063  extern void GOMP_task (void (*fn) (void *), void *data, void (*cpyfn) (void *, void *), long arg_size, long arg_align, bool if_clause, unsigned flags)
4064  1. void (*fn) (void *): the generated outlined function for the task body
4065  2. void *data: the parameters for the outlined function
4066  3. void (*cpyfn) (void *, void *): copy function to replace the default memcpy() from function data to each task's data
4067  4. long arg_size: specify the size of data
4068  5. long arg_align: alignment of the data
4069  6. bool if_clause: the value of if_clause. true --> 1, false -->0; default is set to 1 by GCC
4070  7. unsigned flags: untied (1) or not (0)
4071 
4072  Since we use the ROSE outliner to generate the outlined function. The parameters are wrapped into an array of pointers to them
4073  So the calculation of data(parameter) size/align is simplified . They are all pointer types.
4074  */
4075  void transOmpTask(SgNode* node)
4076  {
4077  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
4078  SgOmpTaskStatement* target = isSgOmpTaskStatement(node);
4079  ROSE_ASSERT (target != NULL);
4080 
4081  // Liao 1/24/2011
4082  // For Fortran code, we have to insert EXTERNAL OUTLINED_FUNC into
4083  // the function body containing the parallel region
4084  // TODO verify this is also necessary for OMP TASK
4085  SgFunctionDefinition * func_def = NULL;
4086  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )
4087  {
4088  func_def = getEnclosingFunctionDefinition(target);
4089  ROSE_ASSERT (func_def != NULL);
4090  }
4091 
4092  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
4093  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
4094  // Save preprocessing info as early as possible, avoiding mess up from the outliner
4095  AttachedPreprocessingInfoType save_buf1, save_buf2;
4096  cutPreprocessingInfo(target, PreprocessingInfo::before, save_buf1) ;
4097  cutPreprocessingInfo(target, PreprocessingInfo::after, save_buf2) ;
4098 
4099  // generate and insert an outlined function as a task
4100  std::string wrapper_name;
4101  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t syms;
4102  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t pdSyms3; // store all variables which should be passed by reference
4103  std::set<SgInitializedName*> readOnlyVars;
4104  SgFunctionDeclaration* outlined_func = generateOutlinedTask (node, wrapper_name, syms, pdSyms3);
4105 
4106  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )
4107  { // EXTERNAL outlined_function , otherwise the function name will be interpreted as a integer/real variable
4108  ROSE_ASSERT (func_def != NULL);
4109  // There could be an enclosing parallel region
4110  //SgBasicBlock * func_body = func_def->get_body();
4111  SgBasicBlock * enclosing_body = getEnclosingRegionOrFuncDefinition (target);
4112  ROSE_ASSERT (enclosing_body != NULL);
4113  SgAttributeSpecificationStatement* external_stmt1 = buildAttributeSpecificationStatement(SgAttributeSpecificationStatement::e_externalStatement)
4114 ;
4115  SgFunctionRefExp *func_ref1 = buildFunctionRefExp (outlined_func);
4116  external_stmt1->get_parameter_list()->prepend_expression(func_ref1);
4117  func_ref1->set_parent(external_stmt1->get_parameter_list());
4118  // must put it into the declaration statement part, after possible implicit/include statements, if any
4119  SgStatement* l_stmt = findLastDeclarationStatement (enclosing_body);
4120  if (l_stmt)
4121  insertStatementAfter(l_stmt,external_stmt1);
4122  else
4123  prependStatement(external_stmt1, enclosing_body);
4124  }
4125 
4126 
4127  SgScopeStatement * p_scope = target->get_scope();
4128  ROSE_ASSERT(p_scope != NULL);
4129  // Generate a call to it
4130 
4131  SgExprListExp* parameters = NULL;
4132  //SgStatement* func_call = Outliner::generateCall (outlined_func, syms, readOnlyVars, wrapper_name,p_scope);
4133  //ROSE_ASSERT(func_call != NULL);
4134 
4135  // Replace the parallel region with the function call statement
4136  // TODO should we introduce another level of scope here?
4137  // SageInterface::replaceStatement(target,func_call, true);
4138  // hide this from the unparser TODO this call statement is not really necessary, only the call expression is needed
4139  // Sg_File_Info* file_info = type_decl->get_file_info();
4140  // file_info->unsetOutputInCodeGeneration ();
4141  //
4142  //func_call->get_file_info()->unsetOutputInCodeGeneration ();
4143  SgExpression * parameter_data = NULL;
4144  SgExpression * parameter_cpyfn = NULL;
4145  SgExpression * parameter_arg_size = NULL;
4146  SgExpression * parameter_arg_align = NULL;
4147  SgExpression * parameter_if_clause = NULL;
4148  SgExpression * parameter_untied = NULL;
4149  SgExpression * parameter_argcount = NULL;
4150  size_t parameter_count = syms.size();
4151 
4152  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language())
4153  { // Fortran case
4154  // void xomp_task (void (*fn) (void *), void (*cpyfn) (void *, void *), int * arg_size, int * arg_align,
4155  // int * if_clause, int * untied, int * argcount, ...)
4156 
4157  parameter_cpyfn=buildIntVal(0); // no special copy function for array of pointers
4158  parameter_arg_size = buildIntVal( parameter_count * sizeof(void*) );
4159  // TODO get right alignment
4160  parameter_arg_align = buildIntVal(4);
4161  }
4162  else // C/C++ case
4163  // void GOMP_task (void (*fn) (void *), void *data, void (*cpyfn) (void *, void *), long arg_size, long arg_align,
4164  // bool if_clause, unsigned flags)
4165  {
4166  if ( parameter_count == 0) // No parameters to be passed at all
4167  {
4168  parameter_data = buildIntVal(0);
4169  parameter_cpyfn=buildIntVal(0); // no copy function is needed
4170  parameter_arg_size = buildIntVal(0);
4171  parameter_arg_align = buildIntVal(0);
4172  }
4173  else
4174  {
4175  SgVarRefExp * data_ref = buildVarRefExp(wrapper_name, p_scope);
4176  ROSE_ASSERT (data_ref != NULL);
4177  SgType * data_type = data_ref->get_type();
4178  parameter_data = buildAddressOfOp(data_ref);
4179  parameter_cpyfn=buildIntVal(0); // no special copy function for array of pointers
4180  // arg size of array of pointers = pointer_count * pointer_size
4181  // ROSE does not support cross compilation so sizeof(void*) can use as a workaround for now
4182  //we now use a structure containing pointers or non-pointer typed members to wrap parameters
4183  parameter_arg_size = buildSizeOfOp(data_type);
4184  // parameter_arg_size = buildIntVal( parameter_count* sizeof(void*));
4185  // TODO get right alignment
4186  parameter_arg_align = buildIntVal(4);
4187  //parameter_arg_align = buildIntVal(sizeof(void*));
4188  }
4189 
4190  }
4191 
4192  if (hasClause(target, V_SgOmpIfClause))
4193  {
4194  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> clauses = getClause(target, V_SgOmpIfClause);
4195  ROSE_ASSERT (clauses.size() ==1); // should only have one if ()
4196  SgOmpIfClause * if_clause = isSgOmpIfClause (clauses[0]);
4197  ROSE_ASSERT (if_clause->get_expression() != NULL);
4198  parameter_if_clause = copyExpression(if_clause->get_expression());
4199  }
4200  else
4201  parameter_if_clause = buildIntVal(1);
4202 
4203  if (hasClause(target, V_SgOmpUntiedClause))
4204  parameter_untied = buildIntVal(1);
4205  else
4206  parameter_untied = buildIntVal(0);
4207 
4208 
4209  // parameters are different between Fortran and C/C++
4210  // To support pass-by-value and pass-by-reference in the XOMP runtime
4211  // We use a triplet for each parameter to be passed to XOMP
4212  // <pass_by_value-ref, value-size, parameter-address>
4213  // e.g. if a integer i is intended to be passed by value in the task
4214  // we generate three argument for it: 1, sizeof(int), i
4215  // similarly, for an array item[10], passed by reference in the task
4216  // we generate: 0, sizeof(void*), item
4217  // As a result, the variable length argument list is 3 times the count of original parameters long
4218  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language())
4219  {
4220  parameters = buildExprListExp(buildFunctionRefExp(outlined_func),
4221  parameter_cpyfn, parameter_arg_size, parameter_arg_align, parameter_if_clause, parameter_untied);
4222 
4223  parameter_argcount = buildIntVal (syms.size()*3);
4224  appendExpression (parameters,parameter_argcount);
4225  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t::iterator iter = syms.begin();
4226  for (; iter!=syms.end(); iter++)
4227  {
4228  const SgVariableSymbol * sb = *iter;
4229  bool b_pass_value = true;
4230  // Assumption:
4231  // transOmpVariables() should already handled most private, reduction variables
4232  // Anything left should be passed by reference by default , except for loop index variables.
4233  // We check if a variable is a loop index, and pass it by value.
4234  //
4235  // TODO more accurate way to decide on pass-by-value or pass-by-reference in patchUpPrivateVariables()
4236  // and patchUpFirstprivateVariables()
4237  if (isLoopIndexVariable (sb->get_declaration(), target))
4238  {
4239  b_pass_value = true;
4240  appendExpression (parameters,buildIntVal(1));
4241  }
4242  else
4243  { // all other should be treated as shared variables ( pass-by-reference )
4244  b_pass_value = false;
4245  appendExpression (parameters,buildIntVal(0));
4246  }
4247 
4248  //2nd of the triplet, the size of the parameter type,
4249  // if pass-by-value, the actual size
4250  // if pass-by-reference, the pointer size
4251  if (b_pass_value)
4252  { //TODO accurate calculation of type size for Fortran, assume integer for now
4253  // Provide an interface function for this.
4254  // Is it feasible to calculate all sizes during compilation time ??
4255  SgType * s_type = sb->get_type();
4256  if (isSgTypeInt(s_type))
4257  appendExpression (parameters,buildIntVal(sizeof(int)));
4258  else
4259  {
4260  printf("Error. transOmpTask(): unhandled Fortran type (%s) for pass-by-value.\n",s_type->class_name().c_str());
4261  ROSE_ABORT ();
4262  }
4263  }
4264  else
4265  { // get target platform's pointer size
4266  appendExpression (parameters,buildIntVal(sizeof(void*)));
4267  }
4268 
4269  // the third of the triplet
4270  appendExpression (parameters, buildVarRefExp(const_cast<SgVariableSymbol *>(sb)));
4271  }
4272  }
4273  else
4274  {
4275  parameters = buildExprListExp(buildFunctionRefExp(outlined_func),
4276  parameter_data, parameter_cpyfn, parameter_arg_size, parameter_arg_align, parameter_if_clause, parameter_untied);
4277  }
4278 
4279 #ifdef ENABLE_XOMP
4280  SgExprStatement * s1 = buildFunctionCallStmt("XOMP_task", buildVoidType(), parameters, p_scope);
4281 #else
4282  SgExprStatement * s1 = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_task", buildVoidType(), parameters, p_scope);
4283 #endif
4284  SageInterface::replaceStatement(target,s1, true);
4285 
4286  // Keep preprocessing information
4287  // I have to use cut-paste instead of direct move since
4288  // the preprocessing information may be moved to a wrong place during outlining
4289  // while the destination node is unknown until the outlining is done.
4290  pastePreprocessingInfo(s1, PreprocessingInfo::before, save_buf1);
4291  pastePreprocessingInfo(s1, PreprocessingInfo::after, save_buf2);
4292  }

4317  // Two cases:
4318  // unnamed one
4319  // GOMP_critical_start ();
4320  // work()
4321  // GOMP_critical_end ();
4322  //
4323  // named one:
4324  // static gomp_mutex_t &gomp_critical_user_aaa;
4325  // GOMP_critical_name_start (&gomp_critical_user_aaa);
4326  // work()
4327  // GOMP_critical_name_end (&gomp_critical_user_aaa);
4328  //
4329  void transOmpCritical(SgNode* node)
4330  {
4331  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL );
4332  SgOmpCriticalStatement* target = isSgOmpCriticalStatement(node);
4333  ROSE_ASSERT(target != NULL );
4334  SgScopeStatement * scope = target->get_scope();
4335  ROSE_ASSERT(scope != NULL );
4336 
4337  SgStatement * body = target->get_body();
4338  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
4339 
4340  replaceStatement(target, body,true);
4341 
4342  SgExprStatement* func_call_stmt1=NULL, * func_call_stmt2 =NULL;
4343  string c_name = target->get_name().getString();
4344 #ifdef ENABLE_XOMP
4345  // assign a default name for the unnamed critical to simplify the translation
4346  // GOMP actually have a dedicated function to support unnamed critical
4347  // We generate a default name for it and use the named critical support function instead to
4348  // be consistent with OMNI
4349  string g_lock_name = "xomp_critical_user_" + c_name;
4350  SgGlobal* global = getGlobalScope(target);
4351  ROSE_ASSERT(global!=NULL);
4352  // the lock variable may already be declared.
4353  SgVariableSymbol* sym = lookupVariableSymbolInParentScopes(SgName(g_lock_name),global);
4354  if (sym == NULL)
4355  {
4356  SgVariableDeclaration* vardecl = buildVariableDeclaration(g_lock_name, buildPointerType(buildVoidType()), NULL, global);
4357  setStatic(vardecl);
4358  prependStatement(vardecl,global);
4359  sym = getFirstVarSym(vardecl);
4360  }
4361 
4362  SgExprListExp * param1= buildExprListExp(buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp(sym)));
4363  SgExprListExp * param2= buildExprListExp(buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp(sym)));
4364 
4365  func_call_stmt1 = buildFunctionCallStmt("XOMP_critical_start", buildVoidType(), param1, scope);
4366  func_call_stmt2 = buildFunctionCallStmt("XOMP_critical_end", buildVoidType(), param2, scope);
4367 #else
4368  if (c_name.length()==0)
4369  {
4370  func_call_stmt1 = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_critical_start", buildVoidType(), NULL, scope);
4371  func_call_stmt2 = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_critical_end", buildVoidType(), NULL, scope);
4372  }
4373  else
4374  {
4375  string g_lock_name = "gomp_critical_user_" + c_name;
4376  SgGlobal* global = getGlobalScope(target);
4377  ROSE_ASSERT(global!=NULL);
4378  // gomp_mutex_t is not declared by the RTL header. We use int instead.
4379  SgVariableDeclaration* vardecl = buildVariableDeclaration(g_lock_name, buildPointerType(buildVoidType()), NULL, global);
4380  //SgVariableDeclaration* vardecl = buildVariableDeclaration(g_lock_name, buildOpaqueType("gomp_mutex_t",global), NULL, global);
4381  setStatic(vardecl);
4382  prependStatement(vardecl,global);
4383  SgExprListExp * param1= buildExprListExp(buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp(vardecl)));
4384  SgExprListExp * param2= buildExprListExp(buildAddressOfOp(buildVarRefExp(vardecl)));
4385  func_call_stmt1 = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_critical_name_start", buildVoidType(), param1, scope);
4386  func_call_stmt2 = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_critical_name_end", buildVoidType(), param2, scope);
4387  }
4388 #endif
4389 
4390  insertStatementBefore(body, func_call_stmt1);
4391  insertStatementAfter(body, func_call_stmt2);

4493  void transOmpThreadprivate(SgNode * node)

4507  decl->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().set_thread_local_storage(true);

4518  }
4519  else
4520  {
4521  // preserve preprocessing information attached to the pragma,
4522  // by moving it to the beginning of the preprocessing info list of the next statement .

4536  // Collect variables from an OpenMP clause: including private, firstprivate, lastprivate, reduction, etc.
4537  SgInitializedNamePtrList collectClauseVariables (SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * clause_stmt, const VariantVector & vvt)
4538  {
4539  SgInitializedNamePtrList result, result2;
4540  ROSE_ASSERT(clause_stmt != NULL);
4541  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> p_clause =
4542  NodeQuery::queryNodeList<SgOmpClause>(clause_stmt->get_clauses(),vvt);
4543  for (size_t i =0; i< p_clause.size(); i++) // can have multiple reduction clauses of different reduction operations
4544  {
4545  //result2 = isSgOmpVariablesClause(p_clause[i])->get_variables();
4546  // get initialized name from varRefExp
4547  SgExpressionPtrList refs = isSgOmpVariablesClause(p_clause[i])->get_variables()->get_expressions();
4548  result2.clear();
4549  for (size_t j =0; j< refs.size(); j++)
4550  result2.push_back(isSgVarRefExp(refs[j])->get_symbol()->get_declaration());
4551  std::copy(result2.begin(), result2.end(), back_inserter(result));
4552  }
4553  return result;
4554  }

4595  SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum getReductionOperationType(SgInitializedName* init_name, SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* clause_stmt)
4596  {
4597  SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum result = SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_unknown;
4598  bool found = false;
4599  ROSE_ASSERT(init_name != NULL);
4600  ROSE_ASSERT(clause_stmt!= NULL);
4601  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> p_clause =
4602  NodeQuery::queryNodeList<SgOmpClause>(clause_stmt->get_clauses(),V_SgOmpReductionClause);
4603  ROSE_ASSERT(p_clause.size() >0); // must be have at least reduction clause
4604 
4605  for (size_t i =0; i< p_clause.size(); i++) // can have multiple reduction clauses of different reduction operations
4606  {
4607  SgOmpReductionClause* r_clause = isSgOmpReductionClause(p_clause[i]);
4608  ROSE_ASSERT(r_clause != NULL );
4609  SgExpressionPtrList refs = isSgOmpVariablesClause(r_clause)->get_variables()->get_expressions();
4610  SgInitializedNamePtrList var_list ; //= isSgOmpVariablesClause(r_clause)->get_variables();
4611  for (size_t j=0; j< refs.size(); j++)
4612  var_list.push_back (isSgVarRefExp(refs[j])->get_symbol()->get_declaration());
4613  SgInitializedNamePtrList::const_iterator iter = find (var_list.begin(), var_list.end(), init_name);
4614  if (iter != var_list.end())
4615  {
4616  result = r_clause->get_operation();
4617  found = true;
4618  break;
4619  }
4620  }
4621  // Must have a hit
4622  ROSE_ASSERT(found == true);
4623  return result;
4624  }

4627  SgExpression* createInitialValueExp(SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum r_operator)
4628  {
4629  SgExpression * result = NULL;

4631  {
4632  // 0: + - ! ^ || ior ieor
4633  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_plus:
4634  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_minus:
4635  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitor:
4636  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitxor:
4637  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_or:
4638  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_ior:
4639  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_ieor:

4642  // 1: * &&
4643  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_mul:
4644  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitand:
4645  result = buildIntVal(1);
4646  break;
4647  // TODO
4648  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_logand:
4649  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_logor:
4650  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_and:
4651  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_eqv:
4652  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_neqv:
4653  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_max:
4654  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_min:
4655  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_iand:
4656 
4657  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_unknown:

4659  default:

4664  return result;

4673  // lastprivate can be used with loop constructs or sections.
4674  /* if (i is the last iteration)
4675  * *shared_i_p = local_i
4676  *
4677  * The judge of last iteration is based on the iteration space increment direction and loop stop conditions
4678  * Incremental loops
4679  * < upper: last iteration ==> i >= upper
4680  * <= : i> upper
4681  * Decremental loops
4682  * > upper: last iteration ==> i <= upper
4683  * >= : i < upper
4684  * AST: Orphaned worksharing OmpStatement is SgOmpForStatement->get_body() is SgForStatement
4685  *
4686  * We use bottom up traversal, the inner omp for loop has already been translated, so we have to get the original upper bound via parameter
4687  *
4688  * Another tricky case is that when some threads don't get any iterations to work on, the initial _p_index may still trigger the lastprivate 's
4689  * if (_p_index>orig_bound) statement
4690  * We add a condition to test if the thread really worked on at least on iteration before compare the _p_index and the original boundary
4691  * if (_p_index != p_lower_ && _p_index>orig_bound)
4692  * statement
4693  *
4694  * Parameters:
4695  * ompStmt: the OpenMP statement node with a lastprivate clause
4696  * end_stmt_list: a list of statement which will be append to the end of bb1. The generated if-stmt will be added to the end of this list
4697  * bb1: the basic block affected by the lastprivate clause
4698  * orig_var: the initialized name for the original lastprivate variable. Necessary since transOmpLoop will replace loop index with changed one
4699  * local_decl: the variable declaration for the local copy of the lastprivate variable
4700  * orig_loop_upper: the worksharing construct's upper limit:
4701  * for-loop: the loop upper value,
4702  * sections: the section count - 1
4703  *
4704  * */
4705 static void insertOmpLastprivateCopyBackStmts(SgStatement* ompStmt, vector <SgStatement* >& end_stmt_list, SgBasicBlock* bb1,
4706  SgInitializedName* orig_var, SgVariableDeclaration* local_decl, SgExpression* orig_loop_upper)
4707 {
4708  SgStatement* save_stmt = NULL;
4709  if (isSgOmpForStatement(ompStmt))
4710  {
4711  ROSE_ASSERT (orig_loop_upper != NULL);
4712  Rose_STL_Container <SgNode*> loops = NodeQuery::querySubTree (bb1, V_SgForStatement);
4713  ROSE_ASSERT (loops.size() != 0); // there must be 1 for loop under SgOmpForStatement
4714  SgForStatement* top_loop = isSgForStatement(loops[0]);
4715  ROSE_ASSERT (top_loop != NULL);
4716  //Get essential loop information
4717  SgInitializedName* loop_index;
4718  SgExpression* loop_lower, *loop_upper, *loop_step;
4719  SgStatement* loop_body;
4720  bool isIncremental;
4721  bool isInclusiveBound;
4722  bool isCanonical = SageInterface::isCanonicalForLoop (top_loop, &loop_index, & loop_lower, & loop_upper, & loop_step, &loop_body, & isIncremental, & isInclusiveBound);
4723  ROSE_ASSERT (isCanonical == true);
4724  SgExpression* if_cond= NULL;
4725  SgStatement* if_cond_stmt = NULL;
4726  // we need the original upper bound!!
4727  if (isIncremental)
4728  {
4729  if (isInclusiveBound) // <= --> >
4730  {
4731  if_cond= buildGreaterThanOp(buildVarRefExp(loop_index, bb1), copyExpression(orig_loop_upper));
4732  }
4733  else // < --> >=
4734  {
4735  if_cond= buildGreaterOrEqualOp(buildVarRefExp(loop_index, bb1), copyExpression(orig_loop_upper));
4736  }
4737  }
4738  else
4739  { // decremental loop
4740  if (isInclusiveBound) // >= --> <
4741  {
4742  if_cond= buildLessThanOp(buildVarRefExp(loop_index, bb1), copyExpression(orig_loop_upper));
4743  }
4744  else // > --> <=
4745  {
4746  if_cond= buildLessOrEqualOp(buildVarRefExp(loop_index, bb1), copyExpression(orig_loop_upper));
4747  }
4748  }
4749  // Add (_p_index != _p_lower) as another condition, making sure the current thread really worked on at least one iteration
4750  // Otherwise some thread which does not run any iteration may have a big initial _p_index and trigger the if statement's condition
4751  if_cond_stmt = buildExprStatement(buildAndOp(buildNotEqualOp(buildVarRefExp(loop_index, bb1), copyExpression(loop_lower)), if_cond)) ;
4752  SgStatement* true_body = buildAssignStatement(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4753  save_stmt = buildIfStmt(if_cond_stmt, true_body, NULL);
4754  }
4755  else if (isSgOmpSectionsStatement(ompStmt))
4756  {
4757  ROSE_ASSERT (orig_loop_upper != NULL);
4758  Rose_STL_Container <SgNode*> while_stmts = NodeQuery::querySubTree (bb1, V_SgWhileStmt);
4759  ROSE_ASSERT (while_stmts.size()!=0);
4760  SgWhileStmt * top_while_stmt = isSgWhileStmt(while_stmts[0]);
4761  ROSE_ASSERT(top_while_stmt != NULL);
4762  //Get the section id variable from while-stmt while(section_id >= 0) {}
4763  // SgWhileStmt -> SgExprStatement -> SgGreaterOrEqualOp-> SgVarRefExp
4764  SgExprStatement* exp_stmt = isSgExprStatement(top_while_stmt->get_condition());
4765  ROSE_ASSERT (exp_stmt != NULL);
4766  SgGreaterOrEqualOp* ge_op = isSgGreaterOrEqualOp(exp_stmt->get_expression());
4767  ROSE_ASSERT (ge_op != NULL);
4768  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = isSgVarRefExp(ge_op->get_lhs_operand());
4769  ROSE_ASSERT (var_ref != NULL);
4770  string switch_index_name = (var_ref->get_symbol()->get_name()).getString();
4771  SgExpression* if_cond= NULL;
4772  SgStatement* if_cond_stmt = NULL;
4773  if_cond= buildEqualityOp(buildVarRefExp((switch_index_name+"_save"), bb1), orig_loop_upper);// no need copy orig_loop_upper here
4774  if_cond_stmt = buildExprStatement(if_cond) ;
4775  SgStatement* true_body = buildAssignStatement(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4776  save_stmt = buildIfStmt(if_cond_stmt, true_body, NULL);
4777  }
4778  else
4779  {
4780  cerr<<"Illegal SgOmpxx for lastprivate variable: \nOmpStatement is:"<< ompStmt->class_name()<<endl;
4781  cerr<<"lastprivate variable is:"<<orig_var->get_name().getString()<<endl;
4782  ROSE_ABORT ();
4783  }
4784  end_stmt_list.push_back(save_stmt);
4785 
4786 }
4787 
4789  // end_stmt_list: the statement lists to be appended
4790  // bb1: the affected code block by the reduction clause
4791  // orig_var: the reduction variable's original copy
4792  // local_decl: the local copy of the reduction variable
4793  // Two ways to do the reduction operation:
4794  //1. builtin function TODO
4795  // __sync_fetch_and_add_4(&shared, (unsigned int)local);
4796  //2. using atomic runtime call:
4797  // GOMP_atomic_start ();
4798  // shared = shared op local;
4799  // GOMP_atomic_end ();
4800  // We use the 2nd method only for now for simplicity and portability
4801 static void insertOmpReductionCopyBackStmts (SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum r_operator, vector <SgStatement* >& end_stmt_list, SgBasicBlock* bb1, SgInitializedName* orig_var, SgVariableDeclaration* local_decl)
4802 {
4803 #ifdef ENABLE_XOMP
4804  SgExprStatement* atomic_start_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt("XOMP_atomic_start", buildVoidType(), NULL, bb1);
4805 #else
4806  SgExprStatement* atomic_start_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_atomic_start", buildVoidType(), NULL, bb1);
4807 #endif
4808  end_stmt_list.push_back(atomic_start_stmt);
4809  SgExpression* r_exp = NULL;
4810  switch (r_operator)
4811  {
4812  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_plus:
4813  r_exp = buildAddOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4814  break;
4815  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_mul:
4816  r_exp = buildMultiplyOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4817  break;
4818  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_minus:
4819  r_exp = buildSubtractOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4820  break;
4821  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitand:
4822  r_exp = buildBitAndOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4823  break;
4824  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitor:
4825  r_exp = buildBitOrOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4826  break;
4827  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_bitxor:
4828  r_exp = buildBitXorOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4829  break;
4830  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_logand:
4831  r_exp = buildAndOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4832  break;
4833  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_logor:
4834  r_exp = buildOrOp(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), buildVarRefExp(local_decl));
4835  break;
4836  // TODO Fortran operators.
4837  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_and: // Fortran .and.
4838  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_or: // Fortran .or.
4839  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_eqv:
4840  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_neqv:
4841  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_max:
4842  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_min:
4843  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_iand:
4844  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_ior:
4845  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_ieor:
4846  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_unknown:
4847  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_last:
4848  default:
4849  cerr<<"Illegal or unhandled reduction operator type:"<< r_operator<<endl;
4850  }
4851  SgStatement* reduction_stmt = buildAssignStatement(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1), r_exp);
4852  end_stmt_list.push_back(reduction_stmt);
4853 #ifdef ENABLE_XOMP
4854  SgExprStatement* atomic_end_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt("XOMP_atomic_end", buildVoidType(), NULL, bb1);
4855 #else
4856  SgExprStatement* atomic_end_stmt = buildFunctionCallStmt("GOMP_atomic_end", buildVoidType(), NULL, bb1);
4857 #endif
4858  end_stmt_list.push_back(atomic_end_stmt);
4859  }
4860 
4862 // e.g. xomp_inner_block_reduction_float (local_error, per_block_error, XOMP_REDUCTION_PLUS);
4863 static void insertInnerThreadBlockReduction(SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum r_operator, vector <SgStatement* >& end_stmt_list, SgBasicBlock* bb1
4864 , SgInitializedName* orig_var, SgVariableDeclaration* local_decl, SgVariableDeclaration* per_block_decl)
4865 {
4866  ROSE_ASSERT (bb1 && orig_var && local_decl && per_block_decl);
4867  // the integer value representing different reduction operations, defined within libxomp.h for accelerator model
4868  // TODO refactor the code to have a function converting operand types to integers
4869  int op_value = -1;
4870  switch (r_operator)
4871  {
4872  case SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_plus:
4873  op_value = 6;
4874  break;

4957

4960  // Keep this will cause duplicated appendStatement()

4968  (buildCastExp(buildVarRefExp(right_operand,scope),elementPointerType),elementPointerType);

4986  SgStatement* init_stmt = buildAssignStatement(buildVarRefExp(decl_i), buildIntVal(0));

4989  SgStatement* loop_body = buildAssignStatement(
4990  buildPointerDerefExp(buildAddOp(buildVarRefExp(decl_left),buildVarRefExp(decl_i))),
4991  buildPointerDerefExp(buildAddOp(buildVarRefExp(decl_right),buildVarRefExp(decl_i)))
4992  );
4993  SgForStatement* for_stmt = buildForStatement(init_stmt, test_stmt, incr_exp, loop_body);
4994  appendStatement(for_stmt, bb);

5062 // during OpenMP lowering.
5063 //
5064 // The reasons are:
5065 // 1)Fortran (at least F77) requires declaration statements to be consecutive within an enclosing function definition.
5066 // The C99-style generation of 'int loop_index' within a SgBasicBlock in the middle of some executable statement is illegal
5067 // for Fortran. We have to find the enclosing function body, located the declaration sequence, and add the new declaration
5068 // after it.
5069 //
5070 // 2) When translating OpenMP constructs within a parallel region, the declaration (such as those for private variables of the construct )
5071 // should be inserted into the declaration part of the body of the parallel region, which will become function body of the outlined
5072 // function when translating the region later on.
5073 // Insert the declaration to the current enclosing function definition is not correct.
5074 //
5075 // Liao 1/12/2011

5077 {
5078  ROSE_ASSERT (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() == true);
5079  SgVariableDeclaration * result = NULL;
5080 
5081  // find the right scope (target body) to insert the declaration, start from the original scope
5082 
5083  SgBasicBlock* t_body = NULL;
5084 
5085 #if 0
5086  //find enclosing parallel region's body
5087  SgOmpParallelStatement * omp_stmt = isSgOmpParallelStatement(getEnclosingNode<SgOmpParallelStatement>(orig_scope));
5088  if (omp_stmt)
5089  {
5090  SgBasicBlock * omp_body = isSgBasicBlock(omp_stmt->get_body());
5091  ROSE_ASSERT(omp_body != NULL);
5092  t_body = omp_body;
5093  }
5094  else
5095  {
5096  // Find enclosing function body
5097  SgFunctionDefinition* func_def = getEnclosingProcedure (orig_scope);
5098  ROSE_ASSERT (func_def != NULL);
5099  SgBasicBlock * f_body = func_def->get_body();
5100  ROSE_ASSERT(f_body!= NULL);
5101  t_body = f_body;
5102  }
5103  ROSE_ASSERT (t_body != NULL);
5104 #else
5105  t_body = getEnclosingRegionOrFuncDefinition(orig_scope);
5106 #endif
5107  // Build the required variable declaration

5124  //bb1 is the affected code block by the clause.
5125  //Command steps are: insert local declarations for the variables:(all)
5126  // initialize the local declaration:(firstprivate, reduction)
5127  // variable substitution for the variables:(all)
5128  // save local copy back to its global one:(reduction, lastprivate)
5129  // Note that a variable could be both firstprivate and lastprivate
5130  // Parameters:
5131  // ompStmt: the OpenMP statement node with variable clauses
5132  // bb1: the translation-generated basic block to implement ompStmt
5133  // orig_loop_upper:
5134  // if ompStmt is loop construct, pass the original loop upper bound
5135  // if ompStmt is omp sections, pass the section count - 1
5136  // This function is later extended to support OpenMP accelerator model. In this model,
5137  // We have no concept of firstprivate or lastprivate
5138  // reduction is implemented using a two-level reduction algorithm
5139  void transOmpVariables(SgStatement* ompStmt, SgBasicBlock* bb1, SgExpression * orig_loop_upper/*= NULL*/, bool isAcceleratorModel /*= false*/)
5140  {
5141  ROSE_ASSERT( ompStmt != NULL);
5142  ROSE_ASSERT( bb1 != NULL);
5143  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement* clause_stmt = isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(ompStmt);
5144  ROSE_ASSERT( clause_stmt!= NULL);
5145 
5146  // collect variables
5147  SgInitializedNamePtrList var_list = collectAllClauseVariables(clause_stmt);
5148  // Only keep the unique ones
5149  sort (var_list.begin(), var_list.end());;
5150  SgInitializedNamePtrList:: iterator new_end = unique (var_list.begin(), var_list.end());
5151  var_list.erase(new_end, var_list.end());
5152  VariableSymbolMap_t var_map;
5153  ASTtools::VarSymSet_t var_set;
5154 
5155  vector <SgStatement* > front_stmt_list, end_stmt_list, front_init_list;
5156 
5157 // this is call by both transOmpTargetParallel and transOmpTargetLoop, we should move this to the correct caller place
5158 // per_block_declarations.clear(); // must reset to empty or wrong reference to stale content generated previously
5159  for (size_t i=0; i< var_list.size(); i++)
5160  {
5161  SgInitializedName* orig_var = var_list[i];
5162  ROSE_ASSERT(orig_var != NULL);
5163  string orig_name = orig_var->get_name().getString();
5164  SgType* orig_type = orig_var->get_type();
5165  SgVariableSymbol* orig_symbol = isSgVariableSymbol(orig_var->get_symbol_from_symbol_table());
5166  ROSE_ASSERT(orig_symbol!= NULL);
5167 
5168  VariantVector vvt (V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
5169  vvt.push_back(V_SgOmpReductionClause);
5170 
5171  //TODO: No such concept of firstprivate and lastprivate in accelerator model??
5172  if (!isAcceleratorModel) // we actually already has enable_accelerator, but it is too global for handling both CPU and GPU translation
5173  {
5174  vvt.push_back(V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause);
5175  vvt.push_back(V_SgOmpLastprivateClause);
5176  }
5177 
5178  // a local private copy
5179  SgVariableDeclaration* local_decl = NULL;
5180  SgOmpClause::omp_reduction_operator_enum r_operator = SgOmpClause::e_omp_reduction_unknown ;
5181  bool isReductionVar = isInClauseVariableList(orig_var, clause_stmt,V_SgOmpReductionClause);
5182 
5183  // step 1. Insert local declaration for private, firstprivate, lastprivate and reduction
5184  // Sara, 5/31/2013: if variable is in Function Scope ( a parameter ) and array,
5185  // we don't want a private copy, since the only thing private is the pointer, not the pointed data
5186  // We had a variable passed as private that has to be used as shared
5187  // We create a pointer to the variable and replace all the occurrences of the variable by the pointer
5188  // Example:
5189  // source code:
5190  // void outlining( int M[10][10] ) {
5191  // #pragma omp task firstprivate( M )
5192  // M[0][0] = 4;
5193  // }
5194  // outlined parameters struct
5195  // struct OUT__17__7038___data {
5196  // int (*M)[10UL];
5197  // };
5198  // outlined function:
5199  // static void OUT__17__7038__(void *__out_argv) {
5200  // int (**M)[10UL] = (int (**)[10UL])(&(((struct OUT__17__7038___data *)__out_argv) -> M));
5201  // (*M)[0][0] = 4;
5202  // }
5203  if (isInClauseVariableList(orig_var, clause_stmt, vvt))
5204  {
5205  if( !(isSgArrayType(orig_type) && isSgFunctionDefinition (orig_var->get_scope ())) )
5206  {
5207  SgInitializer * init = NULL;
5208  // use copy constructor for firstprivate on C++ class object variables
5209  // For simplicity, we handle C and C++ scalar variables the same way
5210  //
5211  // But here is one exception: an array type firstprivate variable should
5212  // be initialized element-by-element
5213  // Liao, 4/12/2010
5214  if (isInClauseVariableList(orig_var, clause_stmt,V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause) && !isSgArrayType(orig_type) )
5215  {
5216  init = buildAssignInitializer(buildVarRefExp(orig_var, bb1));
5217  }
5218 
5219  string private_name;
5220  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )
5221  {
5222  // leading _ is not allowed in Fortran
5223  private_name = "i_"+orig_name;
5224  nCounter ++; // Fortran does not have basic block as a scope at source level
5225  // I have to generated all declarations at the same flat level under function definitions
5226  // So a name counter is needed to avoid name collision
5227  private_name = private_name + "_" + StringUtility::numberToString(nCounter);
5228 
5229  // Special handling for variable declarations in Fortran
5230  local_decl = buildAndInsertDeclarationForOmp (private_name, orig_type, init, bb1);
5231  }
5232  else

5248  // step 2. Initialize the local copy for array-type firstprivate variables TODO copyin, copyprivate
5249 #if 1

5259  if (isReductionVar) // create initial value assignment for the local reduction variable
5260  {

5263  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )

5265  // Fortran initialization statements cannot be interleaved with declaration statements.
5266  // We save them here and insert them after all declaration statements are inserted.

5269  else
5270  {
5271  front_stmt_list.push_back(init_stmt);
5272  }
5273  }

5275  // Liao, 2/12/2013. For an omp for loop within "omp target". We translate its reduction variable by using
5276  // a two-level reduction method: thread-block level (within kernel) and beyond-block level (done on CPU side).
5277  // So we have to insert a pointer to the array of per-block reduction results right before its enclosing "omp target" directive
5278  // The insertion point is decided so that the outliner invoked by transOmpTargetParallel() can later catch this newly introduced variable
5279  // and handle it in the parameter list properly.

5282  SgVariableDeclaration* per_block_decl = NULL;

5284  {

5286  ROSE_ASSERT (enclosing_omp_parallel!= NULL);

5288  SgScopeStatement* scope_for_insertion = isSgScopeStatement(enclosing_omp_parallel->get_scope());
5289  ROSE_ASSERT (scope_for_insertion != NULL);
5290  SgVarRefExp* blk_ref = buildVarRefExp("_num_blocks_", scope_for_insertion);
5291  SgExpression* multi_exp = buildMultiplyOp( blk_ref, buildSizeOfOp(orig_type) );
5292  SgExprListExp* parameter_list = buildExprListExp(multi_exp);
5293  SgExpression* init_exp = buildCastExp(buildFunctionCallExp(SgName("xomp_deviceMalloc"), buildPointerType(buildVoidType()), parameter_list, scope_for_insertion),
5294  buildPointerType(orig_type));
5295  // the prefix of "_dev_per_block_" is important for later handling when calling outliner: add them into the parameter list
5296  per_block_decl = buildVariableDeclaration ("_dev_per_block_"+orig_name, buildPointerType(orig_type), buildAssignInitializer(init_exp), scope_for_insertion);
5297  // this statement refers to _num_blocks_, which will be declared later on when translating "omp parallel" enclosed in "omp target"
5298  // so we insert it later when the kernel launch statement is inserted.
5299  // insertStatementAfter(enclosing_omp_parallel, per_block_decl);
5300  per_block_declarations.push_back(per_block_decl);
5301  // store all reduction variables at the loop level, they will be used later when translating the enclosing "omp target" to help decide on the variables being passed
5302  }
5303 
5304  // step 3. Save the value back for lastprivate and reduction
5305  if (isInClauseVariableList(orig_var, clause_stmt,V_SgOmpLastprivateClause))
5306  {
5307  insertOmpLastprivateCopyBackStmts (ompStmt, end_stmt_list, bb1, orig_var, local_decl, orig_loop_upper);
5308  } else if (isReductionVar)
5309  {
5310  // two-level reduction is used for accelerator model
5311  if (isAcceleratorModel)
5312  insertInnerThreadBlockReduction (r_operator, end_stmt_list, bb1, orig_var, local_decl, per_block_decl);
5313  else
5314  insertOmpReductionCopyBackStmts(r_operator, end_stmt_list, bb1, orig_var, local_decl);

5320  replaceVariableReferences(bb1, var_map);
5321  replaceVariablesWithPointerDereference(bb1, var_set); // Variables that must be replaced by a pointer to the variable
5322 
5323  // We delay the insertion of declaration, initialization , and save-back statements until variable replacement is done
5324  // in order to avoid replacing variables of these newly generated statements.
5325  prependStatementList(front_stmt_list, bb1);
5326  // Fortran: add initialization statements after all front statements are inserted
5327  if (SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )
5328  {
5329  SgBasicBlock * target_bb = getEnclosingRegionOrFuncDefinition (bb1);
5330  insertStatementAfterLastDeclaration (front_init_list, target_bb);
5331  }
5332  else
5333  {
5334  ROSE_ASSERT (front_init_list.size() ==0);
5335  }
5336  appendStatementList(end_stmt_list, bb1);

5349  SgVariableDeclaration* varDecl = isSgVariableDeclaration(declaration);
5350  SgInitializedNamePtrList & l = varDecl->get_variables();
5351  for (SgInitializedNamePtrList::iterator i = l.begin(); i != l.end(); i++)
5352  {
5353  // This might be an issue for extern variable declaration that have a scope
5354  // in a separate namespace of a static class member defined external to
5355  // its class, etc. I don't want to worry about those cases right now.
5356  ROSE_ASSERT((*i)->get_scope() == bb1);
5357  }
5358  break;
5359  }
5360 
5361  default:
5362  break;
5363  }
5364 
5365  } // end for
5366 #endif
5367  } // end void transOmpVariables()

5515  SgOmpVariablesClause* buildOmpVariableClause(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * clause_stmt, const VariantT& vt)
5516  {
5517  SgOmpVariablesClause* result = NULL;
5518  ROSE_ASSERT(clause_stmt != NULL);
5519  ROSE_ASSERT(vt != V_SgOmpReductionClause);
5520  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> clauses = getClause(clause_stmt,vt);
5521 
5522  if (clauses.size()==0)
5523  {
5524  switch(vt)
5525  {
5526  case V_SgOmpCopyinClause:
5527  result = new SgOmpCopyinClause(buildExprListExp());
5528  break;
5529  case V_SgOmpCopyprivateClause:
5530  result = new SgOmpCopyprivateClause(buildExprListExp());
5531  break;
5532  case V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause:
5533  result = new SgOmpFirstprivateClause(buildExprListExp());
5534  break;
5535  case V_SgOmpLastprivateClause:
5536  result = new SgOmpLastprivateClause(buildExprListExp());
5537  break;
5538  case V_SgOmpPrivateClause:
5539  result = new SgOmpPrivateClause(buildExprListExp());
5540  break;
5541  case V_SgOmpSharedClause:
5542  result = new SgOmpSharedClause(buildExprListExp());
5543  break;
5544  case V_SgOmpReductionClause:
5545  default:
5546  cerr<<"Unacceptable clause type in OmpSupport::buildOmpVariableClause(): "<<vt<<endl;
5547  ROSE_ABORT();
5548  }
5549  }
5550  else
5551  {
5552  result = isSgOmpVariablesClause(clauses[0]);
5553  }
5554  ROSE_ASSERT(result != NULL);
5555  setOneSourcePositionForTransformation(result);
5556 
5557  clause_stmt->get_clauses().push_back(result);
5558  result->set_parent(clause_stmt); // is This right?
5559 
5560  return result;
5561  }
5562 
5564  int removeClause (SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * clause_stmt, const VariantT& vt)
5565  {
5566  ROSE_ASSERT(clause_stmt != NULL);
5567  SgOmpClausePtrList& clause_list= clause_stmt->get_clauses ();
5568  std::vector< Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*>::iterator > iter_vec;
5569  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*>::iterator iter ;
5570  // collect iterators pointing the matching clauses
5571  for (iter = clause_list.begin(); iter != clause_list.end(); iter ++)
5572  {
5573  SgOmpClause* c_clause = *iter;
5574  if (c_clause->variantT() == vt)
5575  iter_vec.push_back(iter);
5576  }
5577 
5578  //erase them one by one
5579  std::vector< Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*>::iterator >::reverse_iterator r_iter;
5580  for (r_iter = iter_vec.rbegin(); r_iter!= iter_vec.rend();r_iter ++)
5581  clause_list.erase (*r_iter);
5582  return iter_vec.size();
5583  }

5586  void addClauseVariable(SgInitializedName* var, SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * clause_stmt, const VariantT& vt)

5597  }
5598  else
5599  {
5600  target_clause = isSgOmpVariablesClause(clauses[0]);
5601  }

5607  target_clause->get_variables()->get_expressions().push_back(buildVarRefExp(var));

5610 // Patch up private variables for a single OpenMP For or DO loop
5611 // return the number of private variables added.
5612 int patchUpPrivateVariables(SgStatement* omp_loop)
5613 {
5614  int result = 0;
5615  ROSE_ASSERT ( omp_loop != NULL);
5616  SgOmpForStatement* for_node = isSgOmpForStatement(omp_loop);
5617  SgOmpDoStatement* do_node = isSgOmpDoStatement(omp_loop);
5618  if (for_node)
5619  omp_loop = for_node;
5620  else if (do_node)
5621  omp_loop = do_node;
5622  else
5623  ROSE_ABORT ();
5624 
5625  SgScopeStatement* directive_scope = omp_loop->get_scope();
5626  ROSE_ASSERT(directive_scope != NULL);
5627  // Collected nested loops and their indices
5628  // skip the top level loop?
5629  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> loops;
5630  if (for_node)
5631  loops = NodeQuery::querySubTree(for_node->get_body(), V_SgForStatement);
5632  else if (do_node)
5633  loops = NodeQuery::querySubTree(do_node->get_body(), V_SgFortranDo);
5634  else
5635  ROSE_ABORT ();
5636  // For all loops within the OpenMP loop
5637  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*>::iterator loopIter = loops.begin();
5638  for (; loopIter!= loops.end(); loopIter++)
5639  {
5640  SgInitializedName* index_var = getLoopIndexVariable(*loopIter);
5641  ROSE_ASSERT (index_var != NULL);
5642  SgScopeStatement* var_scope = index_var->get_scope();
5643  // Only loop index variables declared in higher or the same scopes matter
5644  if (isAncestor(var_scope, directive_scope) || var_scope==directive_scope)
5645  {
5646  // Grab possible enclosing parallel region
5647  bool isPrivateInRegion = false;
5648  SgOmpParallelStatement * omp_stmt = isSgOmpParallelStatement(getEnclosingNode<SgOmpParallelStatement>(omp_loop));
5649  if (omp_stmt)
5650  {
5651  isPrivateInRegion = isInClauseVariableList(index_var, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(omp_stmt), V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
5652  }
5653  // add it into the private variable list only if it is not specified as private in both the loop and region levels.
5654  if (! isPrivateInRegion && !isInClauseVariableList(index_var, isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(omp_loop), V_SgOmpPrivateClause))
5655  {
5656  result ++;
5657  addClauseVariable(index_var,isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(omp_loop), V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
5658  }
5659  }
5660 
5661  } // end for loops
5662  return result;
5663 }
5665  int patchUpPrivateVariables(SgFile* file)
5666  {
5667  int result = 0;
5668  ROSE_ASSERT(file != NULL);
5669  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(file, V_SgOmpForStatement);
5670  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList2 = NodeQuery::querySubTree(file, V_SgOmpDoStatement);
5671 
5672  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList_merged (nodeList.size() + nodeList2.size()) ;
5673 
5674  std::sort(nodeList.begin(), nodeList.end());
5675  std::sort(nodeList2.begin(), nodeList2.end());
5676  std::merge (nodeList.begin(), nodeList.end(), nodeList2.begin(), nodeList2.end(), nodeList_merged.begin());
5677 
5678  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*>::iterator nodeListIterator = nodeList_merged.begin();
5679  // For each omp for/do statement
5680  for ( ;nodeListIterator !=nodeList_merged.end(); ++nodeListIterator)
5681  {
5682  SgStatement * omp_loop = NULL;
5683  SgOmpForStatement* for_node = isSgOmpForStatement(*nodeListIterator);
5684  SgOmpDoStatement* do_node = isSgOmpDoStatement(*nodeListIterator);
5685  if (for_node)
5686  omp_loop = for_node;
5687  else if (do_node)
5688  omp_loop = do_node;
5689  else
5690  ROSE_ABORT ();
5691  result += patchUpPrivateVariables (omp_loop);
5692  }// end for omp for statments
5693  return result;
5694  } // end patchUpPrivateVariables()

5697  std::set<SgInitializedName*> collectThreadprivateVariables()
5698  {
5699  // Do the actual collection only once
5700  static bool calledOnce = false;
5701  static set<SgInitializedName*> result;
5702 
5703  if (calledOnce)
5704  return result;
5705  calledOnce = true;
5706  std::vector<SgOmpThreadprivateStatement*> tp_stmts = getSgNodeListFromMemoryPool<SgOmpThreadprivateStatement> ();
5707  std::vector<SgOmpThreadprivateStatement*>::const_iterator c_iter;

5713  var_list.push_back(refs[j]->get_symbol()->get_declaration());
5714  std::copy(var_list.begin(), var_list.end(), std::inserter(result, result.end()));

5719 //Check if a variable that is determined to be shared in all enclosing constructs, up to and including the innermost enclosing
5720 //parallel construct, is shared
5721 // start_stmt is the start point to find enclosing OpenMP constructs. It is excluded as an enclosing construct for itself.
5722 // TODO: we only check if it is shared to the innermost enclosing parallel construct for now
5723  static bool isSharedInEnclosingConstructs (SgInitializedName* init_var, SgStatement* start_stmt)
5724  {
5725  bool result = false;
5726  ROSE_ASSERT(init_var != NULL);
5727  ROSE_ASSERT(start_stmt != NULL);
5728  SgScopeStatement* var_scope = init_var->get_scope();
5729 // SgScopeStatement* directive_scope = start_stmt->get_scope();
5730  // locally declared variables are private to the start_stmt
5731  // We should not do this here. It is irrelevant to this function.
5732  // if (isAncestor(start_stmt, init_var))
5733  // return false;
5734 
5735 // cout<<"Debug omp_lowering.cpp isSharedInEnclosingConstructs() SgInitializedName name = "<<init_var->get_name().getString()<<endl;
5736  SgOmpParallelStatement* enclosing_par_stmt = getEnclosingNode<SgOmpParallelStatement> (start_stmt, false);
5737  // Lexically nested within a parallel region
5738  if (enclosing_par_stmt)
5739  {
5740  // locally declared variables are private to enclosing_par_stmt
5741  SgScopeStatement* enclosing_construct_scope = enclosing_par_stmt->get_scope();
5742  ROSE_ASSERT(enclosing_construct_scope != NULL);
5743  if (isAncestor(enclosing_construct_scope, var_scope))
5744  return false;
5745 
5746  // Explicitly declared as a shared variable
5747  if (isInClauseVariableList(init_var, enclosing_par_stmt, V_SgOmpSharedClause))
5748  result = true;
5749  else
5750  {// shared by default
5751  VariantVector vv(V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
5752  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause);
5753  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpCopyinClause);
5754  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpReductionClause);
5755  if (isInClauseVariableList(init_var, enclosing_par_stmt,vv))
5756  result = false;
5757  else
5758  result = true;
5759  }
5760  }
5761  else
5762  //the variable is in an orphaned construct
5763  // The variable could be
5764  // 1. a function parameter: it is private to its enclosing parallel region
5765  // 2. a global variable: either a threadprivate variable or shared by default
5766  // 3. is a variable declared within an orphaned function: it is private to its enclosing parallel region
5767  // ?? any other cases?? TODO
5768  {
5769  SgFunctionDefinition* func_def = getEnclosingFunctionDefinition(start_stmt);
5770  ROSE_ASSERT (func_def != NULL);
5771  if (isSgGlobal(var_scope))
5772  {
5773  set<SgInitializedName*> tp_vars = collectThreadprivateVariables();
5774  if (tp_vars.find(init_var)!= tp_vars.end())
5775  result = false; // is threadprivate
5776  else
5777  result = true; // otherwise
5778  }
5779  else if (isSgFunctionParameterList(init_var->get_parent()))
5780  {
5781  // function parameters are private to its dynamically (non-lexically) nested parallel regions.
5782  result = false;
5783  }
5784  else if (isAncestor(func_def,var_scope))
5785  {
5786  // declared within an orphaned function, should be private
5787  result = false;
5788  } else
5789  {
5790 #if 1
5791  cerr<<"Error: OmpSupport::isSharedInEnclosingConstructs() \n Unhandled variables within an orphaned construct:"<<endl;
5792  cerr<<"SgInitializedName name = "<<init_var->get_name().getString()<<endl;
5793  dumpInfo(init_var);
5794  init_var->get_file_info()->display("tttt");
5795  ROSE_ABORT();
5796 #endif
5797  }
5798  }
5799  return result;
5800  } // end isSharedInEnclosingConstructs()
5801 
5803 /*
5804 variables used in task block:
5805 
5806 2.9.1.1 Data-sharing Attribute Rules for Variables Referenced in a Construct
5807 Ref. OMP 3.0 page 79
5808 A variable is firstprivate to the task (default) , if
5809 ** not explicitly specified by default(), shared(),private(), firstprivate() clauses
5810 ** not shared in enclosing constructs
5811 
5812 It should also satisfy the restriction defined in specification 3.0 page 93 TODO
5813 * cannot be a variable which is part of another variable (as an array or structure element)
5814 * cannot be private, reduction
5815 * must have an accessible, unambiguous copy constructor for the class type
5816 * must not have a const-qualified type unless it is of class type with a mutable member
5817 * must not have an incomplete C/C++ type or a reference type
5818 *
5819 I decided to exclude variables which are used by addresses when recognizing firstprivate variables
5820  The reason is that in real code, it is often to have private variables first then use their
5821  address later. Skipping the replacement will result in wrong semantics.
5822  e.g. from Allan Porterfield
5823  void create_seq( double seed, double a )
5824  {
5825  double x, s;
5826  int i, k;
5827 
5828  #pragma omp parallel private(x,s,i,k)
5829  {
5830  // .....
5831  // here s is private
5832  s = find_my_seed( myid, num_procs,
5833  (long)4*NUM_KEYS, seed, a );
5834 
5835  for (i=k1; i<k2; i++)
5836  {
5837  x = randlc(&s, &a); // here s is used by its address
5838 
5839  }
5840  }
5841  }
5842 If not, wrong code will be generated later on. The reason follows:
5843  * Considering nested omp tasks:
5844  #pragma omp task untied
5845  {
5846  int j =100;
5847  // i is firstprivate, item is shared
5848  {
5849  for (i = 0; i < LARGE_NUMBER; i++)
5850  {
5851  #pragma omp task if(1)
5852  process (item[i],&j);
5853  }
5854  }
5855  }
5856  * the variable j will be firstprivate by default
5857  * however, it is used by its address within a nested task (&j)
5858  * replacing it with its local copy will not get the right, original address.
5859  *
5860  * Even worse: the replacement will cause some later translation (outlining) to
5861  * access the address of a parent task's local variable.
5862  * It seems (not 100% certain!!!) that GOMP implements tasks as independent entities.
5863  * As a result a parent task's local stack will not be always accessible to its nested tasks.
5864  * A segmentation fault will occur when the lexically nested task tries to obtain the address of
5865  * its parent task's local variable.
5866  * An example mistaken translation is shown below
5867  int main()
5868  {
5869  GOMP_parallel_start(OUT__3__1527__,0,0);
5870  OUT__3__1527__();
5871  GOMP_parallel_end();
5872  return 0;
5873  }
5874 
5875  void OUT__3__1527__()
5876  {
5877  if (GOMP_single_start()) {
5878  int i;
5879  printf(("Using %d threads.\n"),omp_get_num_threads());
5880  void *__out_argv2__1527__[1];
5881  __out_argv2__1527__[0] = ((void *)(&i));
5882  GOMP_task(OUT__2__1527__,&__out_argv2__1527__,0,4,4,1,1);
5883  //GOMP_task(OUT__2__1527__,&__out_argv2__1527__,0,4,4,1,0); //untied or not, no difference
5884  }
5885  }
5886 
5887  void OUT__2__1527__(void **__out_argv)
5888 {
5889  int *i = (int *)(__out_argv[0]);
5890  // int _p_i;
5891  // _p_i = *i;
5892  // for (_p_i = 0; _p_i < 1000; _p_i++) {
5893  for (*i = 0; *i < 1000; (*i)++) {
5894  void *__out_argv1__1527__[1];
5895  // cannot access auto variable from the stack of another task instance!!
5896  //__out_argv1__1527__[0] = ((void *)(&_p_i));
5897  __out_argv1__1527__[0] = ((void *)(&(*i)));// this is the right translation
5898  GOMP_task(OUT__1__1527__,&__out_argv1__1527__,0,4,4,1,0);
5899  }
5900 }
5901 void OUT__1__1527__(void **__out_argv)
5902 {
5903  int *i = (int *)(__out_argv[0]);
5904  int _p_i;
5905  _p_i = *i;
5906  assert(_p_i>=0);
5907  assert(_p_i<10000);
5908 
5909  process((item[_p_i]));
5910 }
5911 *
5912  */
5913 int patchUpFirstprivateVariables(SgFile* file)
5914 {
5915  int result = 0;
5916  ROSE_ASSERT(file != NULL);
5917  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(file, V_SgOmpTaskStatement);
5918  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*>::iterator iter = nodeList.begin();
5919  for (; iter != nodeList.end(); iter ++)
5920  {
5921  SgOmpTaskStatement * target = isSgOmpTaskStatement(*iter);
5922  SgScopeStatement* directive_scope = target->get_scope();
5923  SgStatement* body = target->get_body();
5924  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
5925 
5926  // Find all variable references from the task's body
5927  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> refList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(body, V_SgVarRefExp);
5928  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*>::iterator var_iter = refList.begin();
5929  for (; var_iter != refList.end(); var_iter ++)
5930  {
5931  SgVarRefExp * var_ref = isSgVarRefExp(*var_iter);
5932  ROSE_ASSERT(var_ref->get_symbol() != NULL);
5933  SgInitializedName* init_var = var_ref->get_symbol()->get_declaration();
5934  ROSE_ASSERT(init_var != NULL);
5935  SgScopeStatement* var_scope = init_var->get_scope();
5936  ROSE_ASSERT(var_scope != NULL);
5937 
5938  // Variables with automatic storage duration that are declared in
5939  // a scope inside the construct are private. Skip them
5940  if (isAncestor(directive_scope, var_scope))
5941  continue;
5942 
5943  if (SageInterface::isUseByAddressVariableRef(var_ref))
5944  continue;
5945  // Skip variables already with explicit data-sharing attributes
5946  VariantVector vv (V_SgOmpDefaultClause);
5947  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpPrivateClause);
5948  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpSharedClause);
5949  vv.push_back(V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause);
5950  if (isInClauseVariableList(init_var, target ,vv))
5951  continue;
5952  // Skip variables which are class/structure members: part of another variable
5953  if (isSgClassDefinition(init_var->get_scope()))
5954  continue;
5955  // Skip variables which are shared in enclosing constructs
5956  if(isSharedInEnclosingConstructs(init_var, target))
5957  continue;
5958  // Now it should be a firstprivate variable
5959  addClauseVariable(init_var, target, V_SgOmpFirstprivateClause);
5960  result ++;
5961  } // end for each variable reference
5962  } // end for each SgOmpTaskStatement
5963  return result;
5964 } // end patchUpFirstprivateVariables()

5967 /*
5968  * Winnie, Handle collapse clause before openmp and openmp accelerator
5969  * add new variables inserted by SageInterface::loopCollasping() into mapin clause
5970  *
5971  * This function passes target for loop of collpase clause and the collapse factor to the function SageInterface::loopCollapse.
5972  * After return from SageInterface::loopCollapse, this function will insert new variables(generated by loopCollapse()) into map to
5973  * or map tofrom clause, if the collapse clause comes with target directive.
5974  *
5975  */
5976 void transOmpCollapse(SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * node)
5977 {
5978 
5979  SgStatement * body = node->get_body();
5980  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
5981 
5982  // The OpenMP syntax requires that the omp for pragma is immediately followed by the for loop.
5983  SgForStatement * for_loop = isSgForStatement(body);
5984  //SgStatement * loop = for_loop;
5985 
5986  if(for_loop == NULL)
5987  return;
5988 
5989  ROSE_ASSERT(getScope(for_loop)->get_parent()->get_parent() != NULL);
5990 
5991  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> collapse_clauses = getClause(node, V_SgOmpCollapseClause);
5992 
5993  int collapse_factor = atoi(isSgOmpCollapseClause(collapse_clauses[0])->get_expression()->unparseToString().c_str());
5994  SgExprListExp * new_var_list = SageInterface::loopCollapsing(for_loop, collapse_factor);
5995 
5996  // remove the collapse clause
5997  removeClause(node,V_SgOmpCollapseClause);
5998  // we need to insert the loop index variable of the collapsed loop into the private() clause
5999  patchUpPrivateVariables (node);
6000 
6001  /*
6002  *Winnie, we need to add the new variables into the map in list, if there is a SgOmpTargetStatement
6003  */
6004  /*For OmpTarget, we need to create SgOmpMapClause if there is no such clause in the original code.
6005  * target_stmt, #pragma omp target
6006  * or, #pragma omp parallel, when is not OmpTarget
6007  * inside this if condition, ompacc=false means there is no map clause, we need to create one
6008  * outside this if condition, ompacc=false means, no need to add new variables in the map in clause
6009  * TODO: adding the variables into the map() clause is not sufficient.
6010  * we have to move the corresponding variable declarations to be in front of the directive containing map().
6011  */
6012  SgStatement * target_stmt = isSgStatement(node->get_parent()->get_parent());
6013  if(isSgOmpTargetStatement(target_stmt))
6014  {
6015  Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*> map_clauses;
6016  SgOmpMapClause * map_to = NULL;
6017 
6018  /*get the data clause of this target statement*/
6019  SgOmpClauseBodyStatement * target_clause_body = isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(target_stmt);
6020 
6021  map_clauses = target_clause_body->get_clauses();
6022  if(map_clauses.size() == 0 )
6023  {
6024  SgOmpTargetDataStatement * target_data_stmt = getEnclosingNode<SgOmpTargetDataStatement>(target_stmt);
6025 
6026  target_clause_body = isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(target_data_stmt);
6027  map_clauses = target_clause_body->get_clauses();
6028  }
6029 
6030  assert(map_clauses.size() != 0);
6031 
6032  for(Rose_STL_Container<SgOmpClause*>::const_iterator iter = map_clauses.begin(); iter != map_clauses.end(); iter++)
6033  {
6034  SgOmpMapClause * temp_map_clause = isSgOmpMapClause(*iter);
6035  if(temp_map_clause != NULL) //Winnie, look for the map(to) or map(tofrom) clause
6036  {
6037  SgOmpClause::omp_map_operator_enum map_operator = temp_map_clause->get_operation();
6038  if(map_operator == SgOmpClause::e_omp_map_to || map_operator == SgOmpClause::e_omp_map_tofrom)
6039  {
6040  map_to = temp_map_clause;
6041  break;
6042  }
6043  }
6044  }
6045 
6046  if(map_to == NULL)
6047  {
6048  cerr <<"prepare to create a map in clause" << endl;
6049  }
6050 
6051  if (map_to != NULL) {
6052  SgExpressionPtrList & mapto_var_list = map_to->get_variables()->get_expressions();
6053  SgExpressionPtrList new_vars = new_var_list->get_expressions();
6054  for(size_t i = 0; i < new_vars.size(); i++)
6055  {
6056  mapto_var_list.push_back(deepCopy(isSgVarRefExp(new_vars[i])));
6057  }
6058 
6059  // TODO We also have to move the relevant variable declarations to sit in front of the map() clause
6060  // Liao 7/9/2014
6061  }
6062 
6063  } // end if target
6064 }//Winnie, end of loop collapse

6071 // We now operation on scoped OpenMP regions and blocks
6072 // SgBasicBlock
6073 // / #
6074 // / #

6082 void lower_omp(SgSourceFile* file)
6083 {
6084  ROSE_ASSERT(file != NULL);
6085 
6086  patchUpPrivateVariables(file); // the order of these two functions matter! We want to patch up private variable first!
6087  patchUpFirstprivateVariables(file);
6088  // Liao 12/2/2010, Fortran does not require function prototypes
6089  if (!SageInterface::is_Fortran_language() )
6090  insertRTLHeaders(file);
6091  if (!enable_accelerator)
6092  insertRTLinitAndCleanCode(file);
6093  else
6094  insertAcceleratorInit(file);
6095  // translationDriver driver;
6096  // SgOmpXXXStatment is compiler-generated and has no file info
6097  //driver.traverseWithinFile(file,postorder);
6098  // driver.traverse(file,postorder);
6099  // AST manipulation with postorder traversal is not reliable,
6100  // We record nodes first then do changes to them
6101 
6102  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*> nodeList = NodeQuery::querySubTree(file, V_SgStatement);
6103  Rose_STL_Container<SgNode*>::reverse_iterator nodeListIterator = nodeList.rbegin();
6104  for ( ;nodeListIterator !=nodeList.rend(); ++nodeListIterator)
6105  {
6106  SgStatement* node = isSgStatement(*nodeListIterator);
6107  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
6108  //debug the order of the statements

6110 
6111 
6112  /*Winnie, handle Collapse clause.*/
6113  if( isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(node) != NULL && hasClause(isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(node), V_SgOmpCollapseClause))
6114  transOmpCollapse(isSgOmpClauseBodyStatement(node));
6115 #if 1 // debugging code after collapsing the loops
6116  switch (node->variantT())
6117  {
6118  case V_SgOmpParallelStatement:
6119  {
6120  // check if this parallel region is under "omp target"
6121  SgNode* parent = node->get_parent();
6122  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);
6123  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent)) // skip the padding block in between.
6124  parent= parent->get_parent();
6125  if (isSgOmpTargetStatement(parent))
6126  transOmpTargetParallel(node);
6127  else
6128  transOmpParallel(node);
6129  break;
6130  }
6131  case V_SgOmpSectionsStatement:
6132  {
6133  transOmpSections(node);
6134  break;
6135  }
6136 
6137  case V_SgOmpTaskStatement:
6138  {
6139  transOmpTask(node);
6140  break;
6141  }
6142  case V_SgOmpForStatement:
6143  case V_SgOmpDoStatement:
6144  {
6145  // check if the loop is part of the combined "omp parallel for" under the "omp target" directive
6146  // TODO: more robust handling of this logic, not just fixed AST form
6147  bool is_target_loop = false;

6149  ROSE_ASSERT (parent != NULL);

6151  if (isSgBasicBlock(parent))
6152  parent = parent->get_parent();
6153  SgNode* grand_parent = parent->get_parent();
6154  ROSE_ASSERT (grand_parent != NULL);
6155 
6156  if (isSgOmpParallelStatement (parent) && isSgOmpTargetStatement(grand_parent) )
6157  is_target_loop = true;
6158 
6159  if (is_target_loop)
6160  {
6161  // transOmpTargetLoop (node);
6162  // use round-robin scheduler for larger iteration space and better performance
6163  transOmpTargetLoop_RoundRobin(node);

6165  else
6166  {
6167  transOmpLoop(node);
6168  }
6169  break;
6170  }
6171  // {
6172  // transOmpDo(node);
6173  // break;
6174  // }
6175  case V_SgOmpBarrierStatement:

6177  transOmpBarrier(node);
6178  break;
6179  }

6181  {
6182  transOmpFlush(node);
6183  break;
6184  }
6185 
6186  case V_SgOmpThreadprivateStatement:
6187  {
6188  transOmpThreadprivate(node);
6189  break;
6190  }
6191  case V_SgOmpTaskwaitStatement:
6192  {
6193  transOmpTaskwait(node);
6194  break;
6195  }
6196  case V_SgOmpSingleStatement:
6197  {
6198  transOmpSingle(node);
6199  break;
6200  }
6201  case V_SgOmpMasterStatement:
6202  {
6203  transOmpMaster(node);
6204  break;
6205  }
6206  case V_SgOmpAtomicStatement:
6207  {
6208  transOmpAtomic(node);
6209  break;
6210  }
6211  case V_SgOmpOrderedStatement:
6212  {
6213  transOmpOrdered(node);
6214  break;
6215  }

6218  transOmpCritical(node);
6219  break;
6220  }
6221  case V_SgOmpTargetStatement:
6222  {
6223  transOmpTarget(node);

6238 #endif
